title: Sausage & Egg Breakfast Bites
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Dice the chicken sausages and red onion, then sauté them until cooked and softened. In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper. Add in some chopped chives for extra flavour.

Spray a 6-hole muffin tin with cooking spray. Divide the sausage and onion mix among the muffin holes, then pour the egg mixture on top, filling each about 3/4 full. Sprinkle 10g of grated mozzarella over each one.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until the eggs set. Let them cool a bit before taking them out. These breakfast bites are meal prep-friendly, lasting up to 4 days in the fridge. Reheat and enjoy!
notes: Perfect on the go for those quick mornings!

steps: Batter Preparation: Prepare the recipe batter in an oven-safe ceramic ramekin, 15cm cake tin, or silicone muffin cups. Cover top tightly with aluminium foil to prevent steam droplets entering.
Trivet Setup: Pour 250ml water into the bottom of the Instant Pot inner pot and insert the stainless steel trivet.
Place the dish securely onto the trivet.
Pressure Cooker Steam-Bake: Lock lid, set valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 12 minutes (or 20 mins for dense cheesecakes).

Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) before opening. The pressurized steam heat cooks the batter evenly without drying out the protein powder, creating a decadent, molten, bakery-style texture!
Carefully lift out using silicone mitts and allow to set for 5 minutes before topping and serving.

title: The Ultimate Avocado on Toast
ingredients: 1 large egg white (or 30ml liquid egg whites)

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients
items: 1 large egg white (or 30ml liquid egg whites)

instructions: Begin by finely dicing approximately half of a small red onion. Heat a pan over medium-high and coat with a low-calorie cooking spray. Add the diced onion and sauté until lightly browned, about 5-6 minutes. Once done, set it aside.

In a bowl, mash the avocado using a fork, then season with salt and pepper according to your preference. In a separate bowl, combine the 2 whole eggs and 1 egg white, whisking them together until well beaten.

Return to the pan used for the onions, lower the heat to medium-low, and add another spray of the cooking oil. Pour in the egg mixture, scrambling gently and stirring every 30 seconds. Continue this process for 2-3 minutes until the eggs are golden and fluffy.

Toast your slice of wholemeal bread to your liking. To assemble, spread the mashed avocado onto the toast, followed by a generous helping of the scrambled eggs. Season again with salt and pepper if desired, and finish with a sprinkle of the sautéed onions on top.
notes: Now this...this is art.

steps: Hotpot Grill Mode: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' mode on your Instant Pot and adjust temperature to 'Medium' (or 'Low' on Instant Pot Pro).
Assemble sandwich with seasoned protein, light sauce, and cheese slice. Lightly spray outer bread slices with olive oil spray.
Place sandwich directly in the heated inner pot. Use the flat bottom of an oven-safe bowl or silicone spatula to firmly press down.
Toast for 2-3 minutes until the underside is deeply golden, crispy, and crunchy.
Flip sandwich, press again, and loosely rest the Instant Pot lid on top for 2 minutes to trap heat and ensure cheese melts right through to the core.

title: Easy Single Serve Shakshuka
ingredients: 200g chopped tomatoes - 2 eggs - 1/2 red bell pepper - 1/2 medium onion - tsp minced garlic - 5ml (1 tsp) cumin - 5ml (1 tsp) smoked paprika - 2.5ml (1/2 tsp) chilli powder - 2.5ml (1/2 tsp) sugar (or sweetener - optional) - Salt & pepper (to taste) - 2 tsp olive oil - 40g low fat feta (crumbled on top) - chopped parsley (garnish) - 85g slice of sourdough bread

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients
items: 200g chopped tomatoes - 2 eggs - 1/2 red bell pepper - 1/2 medium onion - tsp minced garlic - 5ml (1 tsp) cumin - 5ml (1 tsp) smoked paprika - 2.5ml (1/2 tsp) chilli powder - 2.5ml (1/2 tsp) sugar (or sweetener - optional) - Salt & pepper (to taste) - 2 tsp olive oil - 40g low fat feta (crumbled on top) - chopped parsley (garnish) - 85g slice of sourdough bread

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the diced onion and bell pepper with a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook for a few minutes until they soften and start to caramelise. Add the minced garlic and stir until fragrant, then mix in the cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, and a small dash of sugar if you’re using it. Toast the spices for a minute so the flavour deepens.

Pour in the chopped tomatoes along with a splash of water, then stir everything together and let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Use a spoon to make two small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each one. Reduce the heat slightly, cover with a lid, and cook until the eggs are set to your liking.

Crumble the low-fat feta over the top and finish with some chopped parsley. Serve straight from the pan with a slice of toasted sourdough on the side - rich, comforting, and perfect for a quick and nutritious high-protein meal.
notes: Feel free to add more eggs!

title: Steak Egg & Cheese Burrito
ingredients: 250ml basic tomato sauce or tomato passata
60ml fat free or low fat milk
6 low calorie tortillas (brand: mission low carb balance)

ingredientSections.name: Taco Ground Steak
items: 250ml basic tomato sauce or tomato passata

ingredientSections.name: Creamy Avocado Sauce
items: 60ml fat free or low fat milk

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 6 low calorie tortillas (brand: mission low carb balance)

instructions: Heat a pan over high heat and lightly spray with cooking oil. Add the ground steak in small handfuls and cook till it gets a crispy sear, break it apart, then stir in paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, cumin, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Pour in the tomato sauce or passata, then simmer and stir on low heat until thickened. Set aside covered.

For the fluffy scrambled eggs. Melt butter in a pan over low heat. Add the beaten eggs, seasoning with salt and pepper. Stir continuously, cooking gently until soft and creamy. Remove from heat and cover.
Now in a blender add the avocado with greek yogurt, milk, honey, lime juice, salt, pepper and blend till completely smooth.

To assemble the burritos, Lay a tortilla flat and place two slices of low-fat cheese in the center. Spoon scrambled eggs on top, followed by the taco steak. Drizzle with avocado sauce, then sprinkle with grated low fat cheese. Fold in the sides, roll tightly, and repeat with the remaining tortillas till you have 6 burritos. Toast in the pan with light butter to seal.

Once cooled wrap the burrito in foil and store in the freezer for months. To reheat, remove the foil, wrap in a paper towel and run under water to soak the paper towel. Squeeze off excess water with your hands then place the burrito on a plate and microwave for 6-7 minutes. unwrap carefully from the paper towel. then air-fry or pan toast on high heat for a couple minutes to get crispy, enjoy!

steps: Pressure Cooker Braising: Place protein filling into the inner pot. Coat thoroughly with the recipe spice blend, garlic, and 100ml salsa or broth (acts as the pressure cooking liquid).

title: Breakfast Crunchwraps
ingredients: 6 mini tortillas (24g each) - preferably lower carb
6 sliced reduced fat American cheese slices

ingredientSections.name: Crispy Beef Tortillas
items: 6 mini tortillas (24g each) - preferably lower carb
6 sliced reduced fat American cheese slices

instructions: Add the lean ground beef to a bowl with the taco seasoning and mix well until evenly combined. Divide the beef into six portions and press one portion onto each mini tortilla, flattening it out into a thin layer. Heat a pan with cooking spray and place the tortillas beef-side down. Cook on medium heat until the beef gets a deep, crispy sear, then flip briefly, add a slice of reduced-fat American cheese to each, cover with a lid, and let the cheese melt. Set aside once done.

In the same pan, spray lightly with cooking oil and scramble the beaten eggs over low heat until soft, fluffy, and just set. Remove from the heat. For the sauce, mix together the low-sugar ketchup, light mayo, and Greek yoghurt until smooth and creamy.

To assemble, warm your protein tortillas so they’re easy to fold. Spread a layer of sauce in the centre, then add one air-fried hash brown, a portion of scrambled eggs, chopped chives, low-fat grated cheese, and one crispy beef tortilla. Gently fold the edges inwards to form a crunchwrap shape.
Toast the crunchwraps in a pan over medium heat until golden and crispy on both sides, pressing gently to seal. Let them cool completely before wrapping.

Wrap each crunchwrap in foil and store in the freezer for long-term meal prep. To reheat, unwrap from the foil, wrap in a damp paper towel, and microwave on high for 8–10 minutes until heated through. Finish in the air fryer or pan for a couple of minutes to bring back the crisp.

title: Cheesy Breakfast Rolls
ingredients: 250g low fat grated cheese (I used 50% less fat) Chopped parsley (garnish)
10 low calorie tortillas (brand: mission carb balance)

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 250g low fat grated cheese (I used 50% less fat) Chopped parsley (garnish)
10 low calorie tortillas (brand: mission carb balance)

instructions: Heat a pan over high heat and spray lightly with cooking oil. Add the minced beef in chunks, working slowly so you don’t overcrowd or cool the pan — this helps develop crispier browned edges. Press each chunk flat with your spatula and sear for 2–3 minutes before breaking it up. Cook until fully browned, then stir in the taco seasoning and enchilada sauce. Mix well until everything is coated and saucy. Set aside.

In a separate pan, melt some light butter or spray with cooking oil and pour in the beaten eggs. Scramble gently over medium heat, stirring every 10–20 seconds until soft, fluffy and just cooked through. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

To assemble, lay out all 10 tortillas. On each one, place 2 slices of light cheese, followed by 1/10th of the scrambled eggs (weigh and divide evenly), then 1/10th of the taco beef, and finish with 25g of grated low-fat cheese. Fold in the sides, then roll over tightly, tuck and roll until sealed. Repeat for the remaining tortillas.

Place all the rolls on a baking sheet and give them a light spray of cooking oil. Sprinkle with fresh or dried parsley, then bake at 200ºC/400ºF for 8–10 minutes or air- fry at 180ºC/355ºF for 6–8 minutes until golden and crispy.

Allow to cool completely before wrapping each roll in foil. For storage, freeze for up to 2 months. To reheat, unwrap the foil, wrap the frozen roll in a damp paper towel, and gently squeeze out any excess water. Microwave for 4–5 minutes, then unwrap and toast in an air fryer or hot pan for a couple minutes to bring back that crispy finish. Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce and enjoy!

title: Sausage & Egg Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Into a greased shallow baking dish crack the eggs and add the Greek yoghurt, mix well till fully combined, then season with salt & pepper and some mixed herbs.
Bake the eggs at 200°C for 5-8 minutes, keep checking on them so they don’t burn! Once cooked slice them into 6 even squares and set aside.

Take the chicken sausages out the casing then mash them up in a bowl, generously wet your hands and shape out 6 even patties. Fry these off with some cooking spray for 2-3 mins on each side on a medium-high heat.

To assemble, lightly toast the sliced muffin, spread 1 light laughing cow cheese on the base, then place the egg, the sausage patty, 1 light cheese single, and your top bun with a layer of ketchup, repeat for the other 5, Wrap in foil and refrigerate for up to 6 days or freeze to enjoy at your convenience.

To reheat from the fridge, unwrap from the foil, wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave for 2-3 minutes till warmed through, flipping over at halfway. To reheat from frozen, remove the foil, wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave for 3-4 minutes, flipping over at halfway, enjoy!

title: Sausage & Egg Breakfast Bagels
instructions: Prepare your protein bagels first (see recipe link in notes). Beat two eggs at a time and pour into a pan lightly greased with cooking spray over medium heat, tilting the pan to coat the base evenly. Cook for a couple of minutes until the top is partially set, then fold in two opposite sides, followed by the remaining two sides, to form a neat folded egg square. Carefully flip to finish cooking, then set aside. Repeat the process until you have four folded egg squares.

Remove the chicken sausages from their casings, wet your hands slightly, and shape the meat into four equal balls. Heat the pan to medium-high, spray with cooking spray, and place one ball in the pan. Lay a small piece of parchment on top and use a spatula or burger press to flatten into a patty. Season the top if desired, then cook for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked through. Repeat until all four patties are ready.

Lightly toast the protein bagel halves. Spread 15g of light cream cheese on each half, seasoning lightly with salt and pepper. On the base half, place a slice of mozzarella, followed by the folded egg, the sausage patty, and the top half of the bagel. Repeat for all four bagels.

Wrap each bagel in foil and store in the fridge for up to 4 days. To reheat, remove the foil and microwave for 2–3 minutes until hot all the way through. Enjoy as a quick, high-protein breakfast option.

instructions: Add the pancake mix ingredients to a blender and blend for at least 2-3 minutes into a completely smooth consistency. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes to thicken up.
Set the stove to high heat and add some low cal cooking spray. Allow the pan to sufficiently heat up first and then pour a small dollop (ice cream scoop size), and turn the heat to medium-low.

Let the pancakes cook for 1-2 mins or until you see bubbles popping on the top, then flip it over and cook for a further minute (no longer). Repeat till the mixture is finished (keep the pan on medium-low to cook the rest).

180g plain flour (you can also use oat flour for more fibre!)

30g vanilla casein protein (I use Protein Works) - sub with whey

instructions: Preheat your oven to 180ºC fan-assisted or 200ºC conventional. Line a 30x40cm baking tray with parchment paper and set aside.

In one bowl, combine the dry ingredients: plain flour, vanilla whey protein, casein protein (or more whey if substituting), baking powder, and a pinch of salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together the wet ingredients: eggs, 0% Greek yoghurt, vanilla extract, and sweetener.
Once mixed, pour the wet ingredients into the dry and gently fold everything together until just combined. Avoid over-mixing to keep the pancakes light and fluffy.

Pour the batter into your lined tray and spread it out evenly by gently shaking the tray or smoothing with a spatula. Top with your choice of fruits or toppings – I used sliced strawberries and blueberries, but feel free to switch it up with choc chips, banana slices or even bacon.

Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until golden and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Once baked, lift the pancake slab out using the edges of the baking paper and place on a raised cooling rack to cool slightly.

Slice into 12 squares and serve warm, or store in a paper towel-lined meal prep container to keep them fresh. To reheat, microwave for around 2 minutes until soft and bouncy. Enjoy with syrup, yoghurt, or extra fruit on top.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Line a jumbo muffin tin (you can find the silicone tray and cups I use here). In one bowl, whisk together plain flour, vanilla protein powder, 0-cal baking sweetener, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

steps: Pressure Cooker Braising: Place chicken breasts into the inner pot. Coat thoroughly with the recipe spice blend, garlic, and 100ml salsa or broth (acts as the pressure cooking liquid).
Lock the lid and set valve to 'Sealing'. Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes (fresh) or 12 minutes (if using frozen meat).

In-Pot Shredding: Open lid: the meat will be extraordinarily tender. Shred directly in the inner pot with two forks—it will soak up all the concentrated pan juices.

instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water according to packet instructions. Drain and set aside.

Dice the chicken breast and season with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spray a pan with cooking oil and place over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until golden and cooked through. Set aside to cool slightly.
In the same pan, add the diced turkey bacon and cook until browned and slightly crispy. Remove from the heat.
Add the cottage cheese, mayo, chicken stock, low fat cheddar, garlic powder, dill, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and honey to a blender. Blend until completely smooth.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, chicken, bacon and chives. Pour over the ranch sauce and toss until everything is evenly coated. Divide into 4 equal portions and store in the fridge for up to 5 days.

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with light cooking spray. Sear seasoned chicken and garlic for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden.
Deglaze Pot: Pour in 60ml broth or water and thoroughly scrape the bottom of the stainless steel pot to lift all browned bits (vital to prevent 'Food Burn' warning).

Layer Pasta & Liquid: Scatter dry uncooked pasta evenly across the pot (criss-cross longer noodles so they don't clump). Pour in sauce/tomatoes and just enough liquid so pasta is 90% submerged (approx 350-450ml). Do not stir pasta down to the bottom.
Pressure Cooker Method: Lock lid, set steam valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 4 minutes (formula: half the standard box cook time minus 1 minute).
Quick Release: Immediately perform a Quick Release (QR) as soon as the timer sounds so pasta remains perfectly al dente.

Hotpot Emulsion: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) and stir in light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, or shredded cheddar. The bubbling pasta starch will instantly emulsify into a rich, glossy restaurant-quality sauce right before your eyes!

instructions: Start by seasoning your lean ground chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, sage powder, black pepper, salt, and your sweetener of choice (I used stevia). Mix well with your hands until the seasonings are well incorporated.

Lightly spray a pan with cooking spray and place the sandwich inside over medium heat. Toast for a few minutes until the bottom is golden and crisp, then flip and repeat on the other side. Once both sides are toasted, cover the pan for a minute to help the mozzarella melt fully.
Remove from the pan, slice in half, and enjoy immediately while it’s hot and cheesy. Perfect for a quick, high-protein meal with a spicy kick.

steps: Hotpot Grill Mode: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' mode on your Instant Pot and adjust temperature to 'Medium' (or 'Low' on Instant Pot Pro).

title: Jamaican Cheesy Beef Patties
ingredients: 140g reduced fat grated cheddar -20g per patty (brand: Aldi 50% less)

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 140g reduced fat grated cheddar -20g per patty (brand: Aldi 50% less)

instructions: In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, curry powder, turmeric, and salt. Add 100g of unsalted butter (cut into small cubes) and mix with your hands to achieve a golden crumbly mixture. Incorporate 100ml milk, knead to form a dough, then wrap with cling film, and chill in the fridge.

For the filling, season beef with garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, ginger, thyme, salt, and pepper. Sauté onions in a sprayed, high-heat pan until soft, add garlic until fragrant, then add in the beef and brown. Mix in soy sauce and beef stock, simmering on medium-low to reduce. Optionally, blend 1/3 of the beef for texture to achieve the authentic filling texture.

Roll out the chilled dough to 0.5cm thickness and cut seven circles 6" inches across (I used a small bowl). Add 1/7 of the filling and 20g light grated cheddar to each. Lightly apply egg wash on the edges with your finger then fold, and crimp edges with a fork. Place on a tray, brush each one in egg wash, and bake at 200°C for 20-25 minutes till slightly golden brown. Serve hot or refrigerate for up to 6 days, reheating in the oven or air fryer for 3-4 minutes till hot.
BONUS: You can freeze the pre-cooked patties to enjoy later at your convenience! Cook the frozen patties in the oven at 200°C for 25- 30 minutes, Enjoy!

Hotpot Steam-Dome Cheese Melt: Flip patties. Lay reduced-fat cheese slices on top. Add 1 tablespoon of water around the outer rim and cover immediately with the lid (set to Venting) for 60 seconds. The trapped steam dome will melt the cheese into a gooey blanket without overcooking the center!
Hit 'Cancel' and transfer patties directly onto toasted brioche buns.

title: Chilli Cheese Hot Pockets
ingredients: 160g reduced fat grated cheese (brand: Aldi 50% less fat)

instructions: To make the super simple dough, add flour and 0% fat Greek yogurt to a mixing bowl. Mix with a fork until you form doughy clumps. Then knead it with your hands into a big dough ball and divide equally into 8 smaller balls.

Heat a pan to high and spray with cooking spray. Add the ground beef, flattening it with a spatula to get a crispy sear before breaking it up and cooking through. Once browned, add fajita seasoning, beef stock, and light cream cheese. Stir on medium-low heat until creamy, then set aside.
Lightly flour your work surface and flatten each dough ball into a circle about 4 inches in diameter. On each circle, add 1/8 of the chilli beef mix followed by 20g of reduced fat grated cheddar.
Carefully stretch and fold in the sides to form a dumpling shape, pinch to seal with your fingers, then press down gently to flatten into a hot pocket.
Add the hot pockets to a pan on low heat with cooking spray and cook for 5-6 minutes on each side, until the dough is fully cooked through and the edges are crispy.

Wrap each hot pocket in foil and store in the fridge or freezer. To reheat in the microwave: unwrap from the foil and cook for 3-6 minutes on high, flipping halfway (if frozen, wrap in a damp paper towel). To reheat in the air fryer: 180°C for 5–10 minutes. To reheat in the oven: 200°C for 5-10 minutes.
notes: These can be adapted to use any filling of your choice!

80g blended 0% cottage cheese (you don’t have to blend it but I like to for a creamier texture)
salt to taste black pepper to taste fresh chopped parsley you can also add some
chopped spinach for extra greens if you’re feeling it!

instructions: Add the cooked chicken to a bowl along with the low-fat cheese, blended cottage cheese, light mayo, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and chopped fresh parsley. Mix everything together until creamy and well combined. You can also stir in some chopped spinach if you want extra greens.
Warm your tortilla slightly so it’s easier to fold, then spoon the filling into the centre. Fold in the sides, tuck the bottom up, and roll into a tight parcel to keep everything sealed.

Toast the parcel in a pan over medium heat with a little cooking spray until the outside is golden, crispy, and the cheese inside has fully melted. Alternatively, air fry at 180°C until crispy and heated through.
Serve hot and enjoy. They’re quick, high-protein, and super customisable, so feel free to swap in any other fillings you like to switch things up.

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray pot with cooking oil and sear seasoned chicken for 3 minutes until lightly browned on all sides.
Deglaze Base: Pour in 120ml liquid (broth, water, or marinara), scraping the bottom of the inner pot thoroughly to lift any browned fond.
Pressure Cooker Mode: Lock the lid and Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes.
Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) to preserve tenderness, then Quick Release remaining steam.
Hotpot Finish: Stir in vegetables and sauce on 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) for 2 minutes until glossy and thickened.

title: Air Fryer Popcorn Chicken
instructions: Dice the chicken thighs into small, popcorn-sized pieces and place them in a small bowl. Add olive oil, cornflour, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Feel free to add any additional seasonings you prefer. Mix well until the chicken is fully coated.

Arrange the coated chicken pieces in an air fryer or on a baking tray. Cook at 200°C for 10 minutes in the airfryer or 12 minutes in the oven, flipping halfway through to ensure even crispiness. Serve immediately with your favourite condiments. Enjoy your lower-calorie crispy popcorn chicken!
notes: Chicken thighs are an absolute cheat code for great tasting and juicy chicken! well worth the few extra calories.

title: Air Fried Crispy Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 500g lean ground chicken (I made mine with chicken breast in a food processor)
100g plain flour (40g for tracking) same seasonings used for the chicken

items: 500g lean ground chicken (I made mine with chicken breast in a food processor)

ingredientSections.name: Flour Station
items: 100g plain flour (40g for tracking) same seasonings used for the chicken

instructions: Start by seasoning your ground chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, black pepper, Parmesan, and 1 egg. Mix it well with your hands until the flavours are well incorporated.

Now, wet your hands and shape out roughly 20-22 equal nuggets, placing them on a lined baking sheet that will fit in your freezer. Once you have all the nuggets, place them in the freezer for 20-30 minutes to firm up.

Meanwhile, make your coating stations. For the wet mix, simply beat one egg in a bowl. For the dry station, mix plain flour with the same seasonings used on the chicken. Once the nuggets have firmed up, dip them first in the egg, then into the flour, and place on a rack.

Give them a spray with cooking oil, then air fry at 200°C for 12-15 minutes in the air fryer, or 200°C for 18-22 minutes if using the oven, flipping them over halfway and spraying once more. Serve hot with your favourite dips and enjoy!

title: Honey Garlic Chicken Tenders
instructions: To start, mix the plain flour, salt, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, and black pepper on a plate for the flour station.

Then, slice each chicken breast into three strips and thoroughly coat them on all sides with the seasoned flour mixture. For the egg station, beat an egg with a splash of pickle juice on a separate plate, and then dunk the flour-coated chicken strips into it until fully coated.

On the final plate, add the cornflakes and lightly crush them. Press each egg-coated chicken strip firmly into the cornflakes to achieve an even and crispy coating on all sides, then lightly spray the coated tenders with cooking oil. Bake them at 190°C for 20-25 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 12-15 minutes, making sure to flip them halfway through.

Meanwhile, melt some butter in a pan over low heat, and add the soy sauce, honey, garlic paste, and chili flakes. Bring the mixture to a bubble and stir until the sauce thickens. Now, place the cooked crispy tenders into the pan and roll them around in the sauce until they're fully coated, then serve and enjoy!

title: Hot Honey Chicken Tenders
instructions: Start by setting up your breading stations. On one plate, mix the plain flour with salt, onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper. In a separate bowl, beat one egg with a splash of pickle juice for the egg station. On a third plate, lightly crush the cornflakes for your crispy coating.

Next, slice each chicken breast into three even strips. Working one at a time, coat each strip in the seasoned flour, then dunk into the egg mixture, and finally press firmly into the crushed cornflakes until fully coated on all sides. Repeat for all the tenders and place on a tray. Lightly spray with cooking oil.
Air-fry at 180°C/355°F for 12–15 minutes or bake at 200°C/200°C for 18–20 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy.
While the chicken cooks, melt light butter in a small pan over low heat. Add sriracha, honey, and lemon juice. Stir and simmer gently until the sauce thickens slightly.
Once the tenders are cooked and crisp, toss them in the hot honey glaze until fully coated. Serve hot with your favourite sides or dipping sauce.

title: Korean Fried Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 120g self-raising flour (sub with plain flour and - 1.5 tsp baking powder 60g potato starch (sub with cornstarch) 1/2 same seasonings as the chicken 1/2 cup flour mixture 1/2 cup sparkling water (Add a spoonful to the flour mixture to make craggly bits - this will make crispier tenders) 30ml (2 tbsp) soy sauce (low sodium) 60ml water 45g low sugar ketchup (brand: Heinz) 30ml (2 tbsp) gochujang chilli paste (use a less spicy one for less heat) 30g honey 15ml (1 tbsp) brown stevia (brand: pure via)

ingredientSections.name: Flour Station
items: 120g self-raising flour (sub with plain flour and - 1.5 tsp baking powder 60g potato starch (sub with cornstarch) 1/2 same seasonings as the chicken

ingredientSections.name: Wet Station
items: 1/2 cup flour mixture 1/2 cup sparkling water (Add a spoonful to the flour mixture to make craggly bits - this will make crispier tenders)

ingredientSections.name: Korean Glaze

instructions: Season the chicken strips with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, white pepper, cayenne, and ginger.

Next set up a flour station and a wet station. In the flour station, mix self-raising flour (or plain flour + baking powder), potato starch, and half of the seasonings used on the chicken. In the wet station, combine 1/2 cup of the flour mixture with sparkling water to create a batter.
Add a spoonful of batter to the flour mixture and mix with a spoon to create craggly bits for extra crispiness.

Dip each chicken strip into the flour first, then into the wet batter, letting excess drip off, then back into the flour, to get the craggly bits. to adhere. Lightly spray with cooking oil and place in the air fryer basket. Air fry for 25 minutes at 180°C / 190°C, flipping halfway and respraying with cooking oil. They should come out golden and crispy.

For the Korean Glaze. In a small pan over low heat, combine soy sauce, water, ketchup, gochujang, honey, and brown stevia. Stir and simmer until thickened. Brush crispy chicken tenders in the Korean glaze. Garnish with finely sliced green onions and your ready to enjoy!

title: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 100g plain flour (not tracked as amount used is only about 10-20g between all tenders)
2 beaten eggs (Roughly 1 egg used for tracking)

ingredientSections.name: Flour Station
items: 100g plain flour (not tracked as amount used is only about 10-20g between all tenders)

ingredientSections.name: Egg Station
items: 2 beaten eggs (Roughly 1 egg used for tracking)

instructions: To start, slice your chicken breasts into three large strips each, then season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper, mixing well until fully coated.

Set up your coating stations: in the first bowl, add plain flour; in the second bowl, add 2 beaten eggs; and in the final bowl, add panko breadcrumbs. Dunk each strip first in the plain flour to help the egg stick, then into the beaten egg, and lastly into the panko breadcrumbs, pressing down firmly to ensure an even coating.
Once the tenders are fully coated, set them on a rack, lightly spray with cooking oil, and bake at 190°C for 20-25 minutes, or preferably air fry at 180°C for 12-15 minutes, flipping halfway through.

When they’re nearly done, melt some unsalted butter in a pan over low heat, add diced garlic and stir until fragrant. Carefully place the cooked crispy tenders in the pan and roll them around in the garlic butter until they're fully coated. Garnish with parmesan and fresh chopped parsley, serve, and enjoy!

title: Honey Buffalo Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 400g chicken tender loins (or chicken breast cut into strips)
45ml franks red hot sauce (or hot sauce of choice)

ingredientSections.name: Chicken Tenders
items: 400g chicken tender loins (or chicken breast cut into strips)
45ml franks red hot sauce (or hot sauce of choice)

instructions: Add the chicken tenderloins to a bowl along with 45ml of Frank's Red Hot, garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, pepper, and a splash of pickle juice for flavor. Mix well until fully coated.

In a separate bowl, whisk together one egg and 20ml of Frank's Red Hot sauce. Place cornflakes seasoned with salt and pepper on another plate, partially crushed. Dip each tender in the egg mixture, then coat with the cornflakes, pressing down firmly for an even coating. Place them on a baking tray and repeat for all tenders.

Lightly spray the tenders with cooking spray and bake or air fry at 200°C for 12-15 minutes, flipping halfway through. Meanwhile make the honey buffalo sauce by adding butter, Franks red hot, honey and pickle juice to a pan. Simmer on a medium low heat till it thickens up, Pour the buffalo sauce over the tenders and enjoy!

BONUS: You can freeze the tenders to enjoy later! Once cooked allow them to completely cool, then store in a ziplock or vacuum seal bag (remove as much air as possible to prevent freezer burn). When it’s time to enjoy, reheat in the airfryer at 200°C for 8-10 minutes till crispy or if using the oven, 200°C for 20-25 minutes, flip halfway.

title: Cheesy Garlic Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 50g light mayo (brand Heinz lighter than light)

ingredientSections.name: Garlic Sauce
items: 50g light mayo (brand Heinz lighter than light)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200ºC or the air fryer to 180ºC.

Dice the chicken breast into small pieces. Season with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cayenne, salt, and pepper. Heat a pan over medium-high heat, spray with cooking oil, and cook the chicken until golden and fully cooked. Set aside.
For the Garlic Sauce: In a blender, combine cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, light mayo, garlic paste, lemon juice, honey, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Blend until smooth.

In a large bowl, mix the cooked chicken, chopped parsley, grated mozzarella, grated cheddar, and the blended garlic sauce until well combined. Then to assemble the rolls: Lay out a warm tortilla and spoon 1/8 of the mixture onto the lower third. fold in the sides and roll tightly. Repeat for all tortillas.
Place the rolls on a baking sheet and lightly spray with cooking oil. Sprinkle with chopped parsley then bake or air-fry for 8-10 minutes until golden and slightly crispy.

Allow to cool then wrap each roll in foil and store in the freezer. To reheat, remove the foil, wrap the roll in a damp paper towel, and squeeze out excess water. Microwave for 4-5 minutes, then unwrap and air-fry or pan-toast on high heat for a couple of minutes until crispy. Enjoy warm with your favorite dipping sauce!

title: Pepperoni & Beef Pizza Rolls
ingredients: 100g low fat pepperoni (I used Turkey pepperoni, regular or beef pepperoni also works)
125g grated low fat cheddar (brand: Tesco 50% less)

ingredientSections.name: Pizza Roll Mix
items: 100g low fat pepperoni (I used Turkey pepperoni, regular or beef pepperoni also works)

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200ºC or the air fryer to 180ºC.
Heat a pan over high heat and spray with cooking oil. Add the ground beef in chunks and sear until about 3/4 done. Add the sliced pepperoni and continue cooking until the beef is browned.

While browning, season with onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, Italian herbs, salt, and black pepper. Stir in the tomato passata, tomato paste, cream cheese, and sugar or sweetener. Simmer until thickened, then mix in fresh chopped parsley. Remove from heat.

To assemble the Rolls: Lay out a warm tortilla and spoon 1/10 of the filling onto the lower third. Sprinkle with grated mozzarella and cheddar, then roll tightly, folding in the sides as you go. Repeat for all 10 tortillas.
place the rolls on a baking sheet and lightly spray with cooking oil, then sprinkle with chopped parsley. Bake or air-fry for 8-10 minutes until golden and crispy then allow to cool.

Wrap each roll in foil and store in the freezer. To reheat, remove the foil, wrap the roll in a paper towel and run it under water to soak the paper towel. Squeeze off excess water with your hands then place the burrito on a plate and microwave for 4-5 minutes. Unwrap carefully from the paper towel. then air-fry or pan toast on high heat for a couple minutes to get crispy, enjoy!

steps: Pro Dough Proofing: Knead your high-protein flour and yogurt dough. Place in a lightly greased bowl inside the Instant Pot, cover with a glass lid, and select 'Yogurt' (Low) for 25-30 minutes. The steady 38°C warmth supercharges the rise in half the time of room temp!
Roll dough into naan or flatbreads on a floured surface.
Hotpot Tandoor Sear: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot lightly and lay dough flat. Cook for 90 seconds until large bubbly blisters appear on top.
Flip and cook 90 seconds on reverse side until charred and cooked through.
Brush immediately with melted garlic butter, fresh parsley, and pink salt.

title: Chipotle Cheesy Beef Rolls
ingredients: 100g light mayo (brand Heinz lighter than light)
100g reduced fat grated cheddar (I used Tesco 50% less fat) Chopped cilantro (or parsley)

items: 100g light mayo (brand Heinz lighter than light)

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients

instructions: Start by preparing the chipotle sauce. Add all the sauce ingredients to a blender and blitz until smooth. Set aside in a bowl or bottle.
Heat a pan over high heat with cooking spray and add the lean ground beef. Cook until browned with a crispy sear, then stir in the taco seasoning and cook through until fully coated and fragrant.
Transfer the taco beef to a large bowl and mix in the blended chipotle sauce, grated cheddar and mozzarella, and freshly chopped coriander (or parsley). Stir until everything is evenly combined.
Warm your tortillas slightly to make them easier to roll. Spoon 1/10th of the beef mixture onto each tortilla, fold in the sides, and roll tightly to form your beef rolls.

Place all 10 rolls on a lined baking tray. Spray the tops lightly with cooking oil and sprinkle with chopped parsley. Bake at 200ºC/400ºF for 8–10 minutes or air- fry at 180ºC/355ºF for 6–8 minutes until golden and crisp.

Allow to cool completely before wrapping each roll in foil. Store in the freezer for up to 2 months. To reheat, unwrap the foil, wrap the frozen roll in a damp paper towel, and squeeze out any excess water. Microwave for 4–5 minutes, then toast in an air fryer or hot pan for 1–2 minutes until crispy again.
Serve warm with your favourite dipping sauce and enjoy!

title: Cheeseburger Roll Ups
ingredients: 5ml (1 tsp) cayenne (or less if you don’t like spice)
1/9 cheeseburger beef mix (weigh total and divide by 9)
20g low fat grated cheese (I used 50% less fat) parsley flakes (garnish)

ingredientSections.name: Cheeseburger Beef
items: 5ml (1 tsp) cayenne (or less if you don’t like spice)

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients Per Roll
items: 1/9 cheeseburger beef mix (weigh total and divide by 9)
20g low fat grated cheese (I used 50% less fat) parsley flakes (garnish)

instructions: Add the lean ground beef to a pan sprayed lightly with cooking spray and let it sear undisturbed for a minute to develop flavour. Break it up with a spatula, then add the diced onion, smoked paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, cayenne, and salt. Mix well and cook until the onions soften.

Pour in the beef stock, then add the light cream cheese, low-sugar ketchup, mustard, and diced pickles. Stir everything together until the mixture becomes creamy, saucy, and fully combined. Remove from the heat and let it thicken slightly as it cools.

Warm your protein tortillas to make them easier to fold. Add one-ninth of the cheeseburger mixture to the centre of each tortilla, sprinkle over 20g of low-fat grated cheese, then fold in the sides and roll tightly into a compact wrap.
Place all 9 roll-ups onto a lined baking tray, spray lightly with cooking spray, and sprinkle with parsley flakes. Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes, or until the outsides are golden and lightly crisp.

Allow them to cool before storing. Wrap each one in foil and freeze for long-term storage. To reheat, unwrap the foil, wrap the roll-up in a paper towel, run it briefly under water, squeeze out the excess, and microwave for 5–6 minutes until heated through. Finish by toasting in a pan or air frying for a couple of minutes to get the outside crispy again.
A perfect high-protein freezer snack — 38g of protein per roll and insanely satisfying.

title: Vietnamese Shrimp Spring Rolls
ingredients: 100g carrot (cut into matchsticks) butter head lettuce leaves

ingredientSections.name: Spring Rolls
items: 100g carrot (cut into matchsticks) butter head lettuce leaves

instructions: Start by prepping the vegetables. Slice the cucumber and carrot into thin matchsticks and set aside. If you're using konjac noodles for added volume, rinse and drain them well.

To roll the spring rolls, fill a shallow bowl with water and briefly dip one sheet of rice paper into it for just a couple of seconds – long enough to soften but not so long that it gets too sticky. Lay the rice paper flat on a damp surface or chopping board (this is important to prevent sticking).

Start by layering on some lettuce leaves, followed by the cucumber, carrot, and a small handful of konjac noodles. Fold in the sides of the rice paper, then begin to roll it up tightly just until the vegetables are enclosed.
Now place the cooked shrimp in a line across the roll, then finish rolling to seal – this way the shrimp show through the translucent paper for a clean look.
For the peanut sauce, simply add all ingredients to a bowl and stir until smooth and creamy. Adjust the water or seasoning to your taste.

These are best eaten fresh, but if prepping ahead, wrap each roll individually in cling film and store in the fridge. When you're ready to eat, place the rolls under a damp paper towel for 5 minutes to help bring back that soft, fresh texture.
notes: Feel free to swap out the shrimp for chicken or any other protein you wish!

steps: Pressure Steam Setup: Pour 240ml water or lemon water into the inner pot and insert the stainless steel trivet.
Place seasoned fish fillets or prawns in a foil boat on the trivet.
Lock lid and Pressure Cook on Low for 3 minutes (prawns: 1-2 mins).
Quick Release (QR) immediately to prevent delicate seafood from drying out. Flake with fork and drizzle with pan juices.

title: Cheeseburger Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 low cal tortilla (Brand: Carbzone 112 cal tortillas)
40g reduced fat grated cheddar (brand: Aldi 50% less fat)

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients
items: 1 low cal tortilla (Brand: Carbzone 112 cal tortillas)
40g reduced fat grated cheddar (brand: Aldi 50% less fat)

instructions: To a pan on medium-high heat add some cooking spray and allow it to heat up, then go in with your lean ground beef, press the beef flat with your spatula and let it sear for a 2-3 minutes before breaking it up, this will give the beef a delicious golden crisp!

Once seared break it up and season it with salt and pepper (use any other seasonings you like too). Cook it off for around 5- 6 minutes till brown. Set the cooked mince aside and place the tortilla in the pan to heat up for 30 seconds.

Once the tortilla is warm, place the mince on one half, followed by an even topping of grated cheddar and sliced pickles. Drizzle over some burger sauce, then fold it in half and cook on both sides for 1-2 mins to melt the cheese and get it crispy.
Once cooked slice it into four segments using a pizza cutter and enjoy!
notes: These are a super quick and easy and high protein snack. Perfect if you are short on time or feeling lazy!

title: Cheeseburger Hot Pockets
ingredients: 400g lean ground beef (5% fat or less)
410g 0% Greek yoghurt optional salt to taste
200g low fat cheese (I used 50% less fat cheddar)

instructions: Start by preparing the dough. Add the flour, Greek yoghurt and optional salt to taste to a bowl and mix with a spoon until clumps form. Then knead with your hands until it comes together into a smooth dough ball. Divide the dough into 8 equal-sized pieces and set aside.

Heat a pan over high heat and spray with cooking oil. Add the lean ground beef in chunks to help develop a crispy sear. Once browned, add the diced white onion and cook for another 2–3 minutes. Lower the heat to medium and stir in the beef stock, light cream cheese, ketchup, mustard, and diced pickles. Mix well until creamy and everything is combined, then remove from heat.

Flatten out each dough ball into a circular shape. Spoon 1/8 of the cheeseburger filling into the centre of each, top with 25g of low-fat cheese, then fold in the sides and pinch the edges to seal. Gently press down to form your hot pocket shape.
Spray a pan with cooking oil and cook the hot pockets over medium heat, lid on, for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Let cool completely before wrapping in foil.

Store in the freezer for later. To reheat, remove the foil, wrap the pocket in a damp paper towel, and microwave for 4–5 minutes. Then air-fry or add to a hot pan for 1–2 minutes to bring back the crisp. Serve hot and enjoy!

instructions: Start by heating a pan with a little cooking spray and cooking the diced onion on medium heat until soft. Add the diced chilli if using, then add the lean ground beef. Let it develop a crispy sear before adding the garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and mixed herbs. Cook until browned and fragrant, then set aside to cool slightly.

Meanwhile, peel and chop the potatoes, then boil them in salted water (starting from cold for an even cook) for around 15 minutes, or until fork tender. Drain well and mash until completely smooth. Let the potatoes cool fully - this is important so the dough forms properly.

Add the cooled mashed potatoes to a bowl with the flour, egg, and a pinch of salt. Mix until a dough forms, then divide it into 8 equal pieces. Lightly grease your hands to make handling easier. Flatten one piece of dough in your palm, add one-eighth of the beef filling along with 20g of low-fat cheese, then gently fold the dough around the filling to seal it. Shape into a ball, then flatten slightly into a pocket.
Place the pockets in a pan over medium-low heat with some cooking spray. Cover with a lid and cook for 1–2 minutes on each side until golden and crispy. Repeat for all 8 pockets.

Once cooled, wrap them individually in foil and store in the fridge or freezer. To reheat from the fridge, unwrap and air fry at 220°C for 8–10 minutes until crispy. From frozen, air fry at 220°C for 13–15 minutes until hot and golden.
Perfect as a high-protein snack or quick meal prep - cheesy, crispy, and unreal for only 296 calories each.

title: 10 Minute Mozzarella Bites
instructions: Begin by unwrapping your Babybel lights. These snack cheeses are ideal for this recipe due to their size and consistency.

Add the cornflakes to a blender and blend into crumbs, but not too finely. To cornflake crumbs, add paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and Italian herbs. Mix these well to create your flavorful coating.
Now, in another bowl whisk 1 egg, take each Babybel and dip it first in the egg, ensuring it’s fully coated, and then in the cornflake crumb mixture till completely coated.

Once all your cheese bites are coated, you can either place them on a lined baking tray and bake at 180°C for 4-5 minutes, or place them on some parchment paper and air fry at 180°C for about 3- 4 minutes until crispy and slightly golden. If using an air fryer be sure to check frequently as air fryers can vary.
Once cooked, transfer your cheese bites to a plate and enjoy while hot!

steps: Batter Preparation: Prepare the recipe batter in an oven-safe ceramic ramekin, 15cm cake tin, or silicone muffin cups. Cover top tightly with aluminium foil to prevent steam droplets entering.
Trivet Setup: Pour 250ml water into the bottom of the Instant Pot inner pot and insert the stainless steel trivet.
Place the dish securely onto the trivet.
Pressure Cooker Steam-Bake: Lock lid, set valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 12 minutes (or 20 mins for dense cheesecakes).

Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) before opening. The pressurized steam heat cooks the batter evenly without drying out the protein powder, creating a decadent, molten, bakery-style texture!
Carefully lift out using silicone mitts and allow to set for 5 minutes before topping and serving.

250g bread flour (has extra protein and helps with the bagel texture)
450g 0% Greek yoghurt sesame seeds (garnish) egg wash (1 egg + tbsp water)

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients

ingredientSections.name: Ingredients
items: 250g bread flour (has extra protein and helps with the bagel texture)

instructions: Mix the flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. Add the Greek yoghurt and stir with a spoon until clumps start to form. Bring the clumps together with your hands, kneading gently until you have a smooth dough ball. Avoid over-handling to prevent stickiness — you can add a light dusting of extra flour if needed, but keep it minimal to avoid adding calories.

Divide the dough into four equal pieces. On a lightly floured surface, roll each piece into a log roughly 11 inches long. Brush one end with a little egg wash, overlap slightly with the other end, and pinch together to seal, forming a bagel shape. Make sure the join is secure so it holds its shape while baking.

Place the bagels on a lined baking tray and brush the tops lightly with egg wash. Sprinkle with sesame seeds — a mix of regular and toasted works well. Bake at 180°C (fan) or 200°C (without fan) for 25–30 minutes, until golden brown and risen. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

Once cooled, slice and store in the fridge, or slice and freeze for convenience. They work well for anything from sandwiches to breakfast prep — see the recipe notes for my high-protein breakfast bagel variation.
notes: You can use these for whatever you like! I made a recipe for some breakfast bagels which use these!

steps: Hotpot Grill Mode: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' mode on your Instant Pot and adjust temperature to 'Medium' (or 'Low' on Instant Pot Pro).

Place sandwich directly in the heated inner pot. Use the flat bottom of an oven-safe bowl or silicone spatula to firmly press down.

instructions: Add the self-raising flour, Greek yoghurt, garlic powder, oregano, and salt to a bowl. instructions: Preheat your oven to 165°C and lightly grease a donut pan.

In a large bowl, combine the oat flour, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In another bowl, whisk together the egg, almond milk, Greek yogurt, low-calorie sweetener, and vanilla extract until smooth.

Gradually add the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, stirring until just combined. Then transfer the batter into a large ziplock bag, cut a small hole in one corner, and pipe the batter gently into the donut pan filling each well evenly (about 1/2 to 2/3 full). Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into a donut comes out clean.
While the donuts are baking, make the cinnamon sugar coating by mixing granulated sweetener, cinnamon in a small bowl.

When the donuts have finished baking cool them just till you’re able to handle but still warm to the touch, this helps the coating adhere better. Dip each one into the cinnamon sugar coating, and enjoy your lower calorie cinnamon sugar donuts!

title: Cinnamon Dough Balls
instructions: Add the bread flour, baking powder, and salt to a bowl and mix to combine. Add the Greek yoghurt and stir with a spoon until the mixture forms clumps. Bring it together with your hands and knead briefly until you have a smooth dough.
Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and roll it into a long, even log - this makes portioning way easier. Slice the log into 10 equal pieces, then roll each piece into a small dough ball.

Place the dough balls on a lined baking tray and brush lightly with egg wash or spray with a little cooking oil. Bake at 190°C for 13–15 minutes with fan, or 20 minutes without fan, until risen and lightly golden. You can also air fry them at 180–190°C (355–190°C) for around 10 minutes, depending on your air fryer.
While they bake, prepare your cinnamon sugar coating. As soon as the dough balls come out of the oven, toss them immediately in the cinnamon sugar so it sticks perfectly.
Enjoy hot and fresh - soft, sweet, and only 52 calories each with over 3g of protein.

steps: Pro Dough Proofing: Knead your high-protein flour and yogurt dough. Place in a lightly greased bowl inside the Instant Pot, cover with a glass lid, and select 'Yogurt' (Low) for 25-30 minutes. The steady 38°C warmth supercharges the rise in half the time of room temp!
Roll dough into naan or flatbreads on a floured surface.
Hotpot Tandoor Sear: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot lightly and lay dough flat. Cook for 90 seconds until large bubbly blisters appear on top.
Flip and cook 90 seconds on reverse side until charred and cooked through.
Brush immediately with melted garlic butter, fresh parsley, and pink salt.

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the cocoa powder, stevia, all-purpose flour, and a pinch of salt (if using). Stir to mix the dry ingredients thoroughly, then pour in the melted light butter and milk. Mix until mostly combined.

Once smooth, add the protein powder — for best results, use a whey–casein blend. This helps create a soft, doughy texture that holds its shape. Stir until a thick, pliable dough forms. If the dough feels too soft, refrigerate it for 30 minutes to help it firm up — this step is optional, but makes shaping easier.
Once ready, divide the dough into 8 equal portions and roll each one into a bite-sized ball. For a final touch, roll them in powdered stevia or powdered sugar to coat.
These are perfect straight from the fridge as a quick high-protein snack. If you're feeling extra, dice the dough into chunks and mix it into your protein ice cream for a brownie-loaded treat.

steps: Batter Preparation: Prepare the recipe batter in an oven-safe ceramic ramekin, 15cm cake tin, or silicone muffin cups. Cover top tightly with aluminium foil to prevent steam droplets entering.

Carefully lift out using silicone mitts and allow to set for 5 minutes before topping and serving.

items: 9 light digestive biscuits - sub with 135g of graham crackers (adjust tracking accordingly)

instructions: Begin by dissolving the sugar-free raspberry halal / vegetarian jelly crystals sachet in a cup of boiling water, ensuring it's completely mixed. Let this cool to room temperature.

In a blender, add 3 cups of 0% fat cottage cheese with 120ml zero- calorie sweetener. Blend for at least 2 minutes until completely smooth. Once the jelly mixture has cooled, add it into the blender with the cottage cheese and blend once more to combined.

For the biscuit base, crush 9 light digestive biscuits (or 135g graham crackers) into a fine consistency. Mix the crushed biscuits with 3 tablespoons of melted butter and press firmly into the bottom of your cheesecake pan to form the base.

Pour the cheesecake mixture over the biscuit base in the pan and smooth the top with a spatula. Chill in the refrigerator (making sure it’s level) for at least 6 hours, or overnight, to allow it to set.
Once set, your low calorie and high protein raspberry cheesecake is ready. Store in the fridge for up to 5 days and enjoy!
notes: A classic dessert recipe from my page. You can use any flavour of jelly with this: lemon, strawberry orange, the possibilities are endless...

title: Mongolian Beef Noodles
ingredients: 700g lean beef steak (Fillet or flank steak)

30ml Halal rice vinegar (or apple cider vinegar + 1 tsp honey)
5g cornflour (mixed with water to avoid clumping)
600g cooked noodles (brand: Amoy, straight to wok medium noodles)

ingredientSections.name: Crispy Beef
items: 700g lean beef steak (Fillet or flank steak)

items: 30ml Halal rice vinegar (or apple cider vinegar + 1 tsp honey)
5g cornflour (mixed with water to avoid clumping)

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 600g cooked noodles (brand: Amoy, straight to wok medium noodles)

instructions: Begin by slicing the beef into thin strips. In a mixing bowl, combine the beef with baking soda, cornflour, salt, pepper, and sesame oil. Mix well with your hands until the beef is fully coated. Heat a pan over high heat. Add the beef and cook for about 8-10 minutes until crispy. Once done, remove the beef from the pan and set it aside.

To prepare the Mongolian sauce, combine oyster sauce, halal rice vinegar + pinch of sweetener (or halal rice vinegar), soy sauce, brown stevia, and cornflour (mixed with a little water to prevent clumping) in a mixing jug. Stir well until everything is combined.

In the same pan used for the beef, add ginger, garlic, white onion, and the white parts of the green onions. Sauté until they soften. Then add the shiitake mushrooms with a splash of water and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the mushrooms are soft.

Return the beef to the pan along with the Mongolian sauce and cooked noodles. Reduce the heat to low and stir everything together until well mixed. Add the green parts of the green onions and stir them through the mixture. Garnish with sesame seeds.

Divide the mongolian beef noodles into four equal servings. Store in meal prep containers and refrigerate for up to 5 days. To reheat, microwave with a teaspoon of water, partially covered, for 3-4 minutes. Enjoy!

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with light cooking spray. Sear seasoned lean beef and garlic for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden.
Deglaze Pot: Pour in 60ml broth or water and thoroughly scrape the bottom of the stainless steel pot to lift all browned bits (vital to prevent 'Food Burn' warning).

Layer Pasta & Liquid: Scatter dry uncooked pasta evenly across the pot (criss-cross longer noodles so they don't clump). Pour in sauce/tomatoes and just enough liquid so pasta is 90% submerged (approx 350-450ml). Do not stir pasta down to the bottom.
Pressure Cooker Method: Lock lid, set steam valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 4 minutes (formula: half the standard box cook time minus 1 minute).
Quick Release: Immediately perform a Quick Release (QR) as soon as the timer sounds so pasta remains perfectly al dente.

Hotpot Emulsion: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) and stir in light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, or shredded cheddar. The bubbling pasta starch will instantly emulsify into a rich, glossy restaurant-quality sauce right before your eyes!

Spray a large pan or wok with cooking spray and place over medium-high heat. Add the broccoli and sauté for a few minutes until lightly browned and tender with a slight crunch. Remove and set aside.

Air fry at 180°C for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway, or oven bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes until golden and crispy.

Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes and place in a bowl with 2 tsp garlic powder, 5ml (1 tsp) onion powder, 5ml (1 tsp) white pepper, 5ml (1 tsp) paprika, and 1 egg white. Mix well to coat evenly. Add the chicken to a large container with 80g cornflour/cornstarch, seal with a lid, and shake well to coat — work in batches if needed to avoid clumping. Lightly spray the coated chicken with cooking oil, then air fry at 200°C for 10–12 minutes or bake at 200°C for 18–20 minutes until golden and cooked through.

Meanwhile, make the sesame glaze by adding 60ml soy sauce, 150ml chicken stock, 15ml rice vinegar, 2 minced garlic cloves, 20ml sesame oil, 45g honey, 30g brown sugar alternative, 1/2 tsp ginger, and 2 tsp cornstarch to a jug. Mix until smooth, then pour into a pan over medium heat. Simmer, stirring continuously, until thickened. Add the crispy popcorn chicken to the pan and toss to coat in the glaze. Garnish with sesame seeds.

Divide the potatoes and glazed chicken into 4 meal prep containers, topping with chopped green onions for colour. Store in the fridge for up to 5 days. To reheat, add the contents to a pan and warm through, or microwave for 3 minutes until piping hot.

instantPot.mode: Pressure Steam (High) then Hotpot / Air Fry Crisp
steps: Steam Trivet Setup: Pour 240ml water into the bottom of the inner pot and place the stainless steel trivet inside.
Place seasoned chicken tenders/wings in a single layer on the trivet or inside a steamer basket above the water.
Pressure Cooker Steaming: Lock lid, set valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 6 minutes (tenders) or 10 minutes (wings). Quick Release (QR).
Remove trivet and discard water. Chicken is now thoroughly cooked, succulent, and juicy inside.

Hotpot Crisping: Wipe pot, spray with oil on 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High) and toss chicken in glaze/crumbs for 3 minutes to sear crisp (or attach the Instant Pot Air Fryer Crisp Lid at 204°C for 6 minutes for extreme crunch)!

title: Cheesy BBQ Chicken Fries
ingredients: 130g cooked chicken breast (shred with two forks or your hands) I poached mine
30g bbq sauce (brand: Tesco - 16 cals per tbsp)
cooking spray salt to taste (and any other seasoning you like)
0g low fat grated cheese (I used 50% less fat + some mozzarella for the cheese pull) drizzle BBQ sauce topping chopped green onions (tops)

instructions: Start by slicing your potatoes into thin fries, then place them in a bowl of ice water for 10–15 minutes to draw out excess starch. Drain and pat them completely dry using a clean towel. Lightly spray with cooking oil and spread them out on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 200ºC/400ºF for 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway, or air-fry at 180ºC/355ºF for 20–25 minutes until golden and crispy.

Meanwhile, prepare the BBQ chicken. Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a little cooking spray. Add the diced red onion and sauté until soft and fragrant. Stir in the tomato paste and BBQ sauce and toast for a minute to deepen the flavour. Then pour in the chicken stock, followed by the light cream cheese and all the seasonings. Stir until smooth and creamy.

Add in the shredded chicken (or diced if you prefer), and mix well to coat everything in the sauce. Let it simmer gently for a couple of minutes until hot and creamy. To serve, season your fries with salt and pile them onto a plate. Top with the BBQ chicken mixture, sprinkle over your grated low-fat cheese, and place under the grill (or in the air fryer) for a minute or two until melted and gooey.
Finish with a drizzle of BBQ sauce and chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy!

steps: Pressure Cooker Steaming: Pour 240ml water into the inner pot and insert the stainless steel trivet.
Place peeled and diced potatoes (2cm cubes) in a steamer basket on top of the trivet.
Lock lid and Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes until fork-tender.
Quick Release (QR) immediately. Transfer potatoes to a bowl and mash directly with Greek yogurt, splash of milk, garlic powder, and pink salt for the creamiest high-protein mash!
Hotpot Roasties / Wedges: Alternatively, toss steamed potatoes in seasoning and roast in pot on 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High) or with Air Fryer lid at 200°C for 6 mins.

title: Chicken Shawarma Loaded Fries
ingredients: 1000g boneless skinless chicken thighs (trim excess fat)
sliced gherkins fresh parsley to garnish

instructions: Slice the potatoes into fry shapes, then toss them with smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, salt, and a good spray of cooking oil (or a drizzle of olive oil). Air fry at 180°C for 25–30 minutes or oven bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes, shaking halfway, until the fries are golden and crispy.

While they cook, trim the chicken thighs and add them to a bowl with the Greek yoghurt, lemon juice, honey, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, allspice, cayenne, oregano, cumin, and salt. Mix well to coat, then marinate for at least 30 minutes (overnight is even better). Air fry at 180°C for 15–20 minutes or oven bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway. Once cooked, slice into strips.
For the garlic white sauce, mix together the Greek yoghurt, light mayo, garlic powder, honey, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and enough water to reach your preferred consistency.

To make quick pickled red onions, thinly slice the onion and add it to a heat-safe jar. Bring the vinegar, water, and sugar to a boil, then pour it over the onions. Seal the jar and let it pickle for 30–60 minutes.

Now assemble your loaded fries: start with a base of crispy fries, add the sliced shawarma chicken, then top with pickled onions, sliced gherkins, plenty of garlic white sauce, and a sprinkle of chopped parsley.

For meal prep, store the fries, chicken, sauce, and toppings in separate containers for up to 5 days. Reheat the fries in the air fryer or oven to get them crispy again, warm the chicken in the microwave for 2–3 minutes, then build your loaded fries fresh.

Deglaze Base: Pour in 120ml liquid (broth, water, or marinara), scraping the bottom of the inner pot thoroughly to lift any browned fond.
Pressure Cooker Mode: Lock the lid and Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes.

Hotpot Finish: Stir in vegetables and sauce on 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) for 2 minutes until glossy and thickened.

For the creamy chipotle sauce, in a blender cup add greek yoghurt, light mayo, chipotle chilli paste, lime juice and honey. Then blend till completely smooth and creamy.
finally for the salad, in a large bowl mix chopped lettuce, diced red onion, tomatoes and cucumber, lime juice and a pinch of salt. toss together.

instantPot.mode: Pressure Cook (High) then Hotpot / Sauté to Toast
steps: Pressure Cooker Braising: Place lean beef into the inner pot. Coat thoroughly with the recipe spice blend, garlic, and 100ml salsa or broth (acts as the pressure cooking liquid).
Lock the lid and set valve to 'Sealing'. Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes (fresh) or 12 minutes (if using frozen meat).
Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) to lock in natural juices, then vent remaining pressure.
In-Pot Shredding: Open lid: the meat will be extraordinarily tender. Shred directly in the inner pot with two forks—it will soak up all the concentrated pan juices.
Stir in light cream cheese, black beans, or sauce right in the pot using residual heat.

Hotpot Griddle & Toast: To toast assembled wraps/taquitos: wipe pot dry, set to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Med) with a light spritz of oil and toast both sides for 2 minutes until crisp and cheese melts (or use Instant Pot Air Fryer Crisp Lid at 200°C for 4 mins)!

title: Chilli Cheese Loaded Fries

5ml (1 tsp) salt & pepper light cooking spray
900g store bought fries (opt for the chunkier ones as they are less cals)

instructions: Start by heating a pan over medium-high heat. Spray some light cooking spray and sauté the diced white onion until it becomes translucent. Add the ground beef, breaking it apart with a spatula, and cook until it’s nicely browned.
Stir in the chilli con carne sauce mix, a teaspoon each of paprika, salt, and pepper. Let it simmer on low heat for 5-10 minutes until the mixture thickens.

While the chilli is cooking, prepare your fries. Spread the fries on a baking tray and cook them according to the package instructions. Once cooked, toss them in a bowl with a teaspoon of paprika, salt, and pepper for added flavor.
For the cheese sauce, tear the cheese slices into a microwave-safe bowl, pour in the milk, and microwave for 30-40 seconds. Stir every 10 seconds until it’s smooth and creamy.

To assemble, divide the fries into four equal portions. Top each with a quarter of the chilli con carne mixture and a generous drizzle of cheese sauce. Garnish with chopped green onions, sliced red chillies, and if you like, a drizzle of garlic mayo.

To reheat, transfer the loaded fries onto a square sheet of tin foil using a large spatula. Reheat in the air fryer or oven at 200°C for 6-8 minutes. Warm the cheese sauce separately and pour it over the fries just before serving. Enjoy!

instantPot.liquidRequired: 200-250ml broth, coconut milk or tomato passata
steps: Hotpot Sauté Aromatics: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Sauté onions, garlic, ginger, and curry spices in cooking spray for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add seasoned beef and sear on Hotpot mode for 3 minutes to lock in flavor.
Pour in 200ml cooking liquid (broth, light coconut milk, or passata) and thoroughly scrape the pot base clean to avoid burn warnings.
Pressure Cooker Mode: Lock lid and Pressure Cook on High for 10 minutes (chicken/veg) or 15 minutes (beef/beans).
Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) to let spices meld deeply and meat turn melt-in-the-mouth tender.
Hotpot Table Serving: Vent remaining steam, press 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) to simmer and thicken for 2 minutes, stirring in Greek yogurt or fresh coriander before serving directly at the table.

title: Garlic Butter Steak & Potatoes

5g cornstarch mixed with a tsp of water

5g cornstarch mixed with a tsp of water

instructions: Dice the potatoes into small cubes and add them to a bowl. Season with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, parsley, salt, and pepper. Spray them lightly with cooking oil and mix well. Meanwhile, dice your steak into cubes and season with salt and pepper. Cook in a pan over high heat using cooking spray until they're golden and crispy. Lower the heat, add 15g of unsalted butter, minced garlic, and a sprinkle of parsley. Stir for a couple more minutes until the butter has melted and the steak bites are well-coated.

Set the steak bites aside. In the same pan, melt 5g of butter, then add beef stock, partially crushed peppercorns, and chopped garlic. Bring to a simmer. Once bubbling, reduce heat and add the light cream cheese, followed by the cornstarch mixed with water to thicken the sauce.

Package in meal prep boxes, keeping the sauce separate (I used plastic shot glasses). Store in the fridge for up to 5 days. When you're ready to eat, reheat the potatoes in the air fryer for 2-3 minutes until crispy. Microwave the steak bites for 2-3 minutes until hot. Microwave the sauce for 15-20 seconds, then pour over the steak bites and enjoy!

instantPot.liquidRequired: Cooking spray / 1 tbsp water for steam dome
steps: Hotpot Griddle Mode: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High) and allow the stainless steel inner pot to heat for 2 minutes until sizzling hot.
Spray with light oil. Place formed burger patties or seasoned steak bites flat on the surface. Sear undisturbed for 3 minutes until a deep golden crust forms.

Hotpot Steam-Dome Cheese Melt: Flip patties. Lay reduced-fat cheese slices on top. Add 1 tablespoon of water around the outer rim and cover immediately with the lid (set to Venting) for 60 seconds. The trapped steam dome will melt the cheese into a gooey blanket without overcooking the center!
Hit 'Cancel' and transfer patties directly onto toasted brioche buns.

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with light cooking spray. Sear seasoned lean beef and garlic for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden.

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with light cooking spray. Sear seasoned lean beef and garlic for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden.

Hotpot Emulsion: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) and stir in light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, or shredded cheddar. The bubbling pasta starch will instantly emulsify into a rich, glossy restaurant-quality sauce right before your eyes!

instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C. In a mixing bowl, combine 110g of plain flour, a teaspoon of baking powder, and a pinch of salt. Once you have cheese all around the perimeter, fold the dough over the cheese and pinch to seal the stuffed crust.

Spread 15g of pizza sauce evenly over the base, leaving the stuffed crust exposed. Sprinkle 60g of low-fat grated cheddar over the sauce, followed by 160g of cooked, seasoned chicken breast slices (seasoned with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper). title: Royal Kashmiri Pink Tea (Noon Chai) — High Protein
ingredients: 15g (2 tbsp) authentic Kashmiri green tea leaves (Noon Chai leaves)
500ml cold filtered water (divided: 250ml for reduction + 250ml ice-cold water)
1.5g (1/4 tsp) baking soda (sodium bicarbonate - vital catalyst for pink reaction)
25g unflavoured whey isolate or vanilla protein powder (Protein Works)
1.5g (1/4 tsp) Himalayan pink salt (traditional Kashmiri pinch) or 0-cal sweetener to taste
10g crushed pistachios and slivered almonds (for royal garnish)

ingredientSections.name: Tea Kehva (Base Liquor)
items: 15g (2 tbsp) authentic Kashmiri green tea leaves (Noon Chai leaves)

ingredientSections.name: High Protein Milk & Garnish
items: 25g unflavoured whey isolate or vanilla protein powder (Protein Works)
1.5g (1/4 tsp) Himalayan pink salt or 0-cal sweetener to taste
10g crushed pistachios and slivered almonds (for royal garnish)

instructions: In a saucepan (or Instant Pot on Sauté mode), add 250ml cold water, Kashmiri tea leaves, crushed cardamom, cinnamon stick, and star anise. Bring to a rolling boil over medium-high heat.
Add the 1.5g (1/4 tsp) baking soda. The tea will vigorously froth and transition from green to a deep crimson-maroon hue. Whisk briskly for 20 seconds.
Simmer on medium heat for 8-10 minutes until the liquid reduces by roughly half into a concentrated dark kehva.

Pour in the 250ml of ice-cold water. Using a ladle, vigorously scoop and pour the tea back into the pot from a 20cm height continuously for 3 minutes. This rapid thermal shock and aeration binds oxygen to the tea polyphenols, locking in the ruby pigment.
Pour in the 300ml of low-fat warm milk. Instantly marvel as the liquid transforms into a rich, pastel blossom pink! Whisk in the protein powder and a pinch of pink salt (or sweetener).
Simmer gently for 2 minutes without boiling over. Strain through a fine-mesh tea sieve into two warm mugs, crown with crushed pistachios and slivered almonds, and serve steaming hot.
notes: Authentic Kashmiri Noon Chai achieves its iconic natural pink color via the chemical interaction between tea polyphenols, baking soda (alkaline environment), and cold-water aeration — never artificial food dyes! For a sweeter profile, replace the pinch of salt with Pure Via stevia or a drizzle of honey.

steps: Hotpot Setup: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' mode on High. Add 250ml cold water, Kashmiri tea leaves, crushed cardamom pods, cinnamon, and star anise directly into the inner pot. Bring to a rolling boil.
Whisk in 1/4 tsp baking soda. Watch the tea vigorously froth and deepen into a rich burgundy-red hue. Simmer on Hotpot mode for 8 minutes until reduced by half into a dark kehva liquor.

Cold Shock Aeration: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low). Pour in 250ml ice-cold water. Using a ladle, continuously scoop and pour the tea from height for 2-3 minutes to aerate and shock the vivid blossom pink pigment.
High Protein Infusion: Pour in 300ml milk, unflavoured protein powder, and a pinch of Himalayan pink salt. Simmer gently for 2 minutes without boiling over.
Hotpot Keep Warm: Hit 'Keep Warm' to hold tea piping hot for guests. Strain into warm mugs and crown with crushed pistachios and slivered almonds!

title: Cheesy Beef Bulking Omelette

instructions: Begin by heating the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Once the oil is hot, add the diced onions and fry until they turn translucent.
Next, add the ground beef to the pan. Break it up with your spatula, season with salt and pepper, and cook until it’s browned and cooked through.

Spread the cooked beef evenly across the pan then pour the beaten eggs over the beef, ensuring they cover the beef evenly. Season the eggs with a bit more salt and pepper and sprinkle grated cheddar on one half of the omelette. Once the cheese has melted and the top of the omelete is partially cooked, carefully fold the omelette in half, enclosing the cheesy side. title: Big Boy Breakfast Burritos
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Diced your potatoes into cubes, then add the olive oil to a pan on medium- high heat and allow it to heat up. Once hot, add the diced potatoes (season to taste). Cook the potatoes till crispy and golden, then remove and set aside. Check the notes section below to do these in the oven or air-fryer.
In a Bowl crack 8 eggs and beat. To the same pan, turn the heat to low and melt 20g of butter. Add the beaten eggs, stirring every 30 seconds till light and fluffy (season to taste)

Turn the heat back up to medium, then add diced onions and diced garlic. Once fragrant, add the sausages, break them up with the spatula and season with paprika and cumin. Cook through, then set aside.

To reheat from the fridge, unwrap from the foil and microwave for 3-4 minutes on 75% power until warmed through. To reheat from the freezer, unwrap the burrito and microwave for 6-7 minutes at 50% power, turn over halfway for an even reheat. Optionally toast in a pan after reheating for a crispier finish.
notes: You can also cook the potatoes in the airfryer at 200°C/200°C for 20-25 minutes, or oven at 200°C for 30 minutes.

steps: Batter Preparation: Prepare the recipe batter in an oven-safe ceramic ramekin, 15cm cake tin, or silicone muffin cups. Cover top tightly with aluminium foil to prevent steam droplets entering.

title: Cheesy Giant Meatball Sub
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Add the ground beef to a mixing bowl with diced garlic, finely chopped basil, salt, dried sage, onion powder, grated parmesan and panko bread crumbs. Mix to combine, then shape the beef out into four meatballs. Aim for uniform size to ensure they cook evenly. Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Once hot, add the meatballs and cook until browned on all sides and almost cooked through (around 10-15 minutes).

Once the meatballs are cooked, pour the pizza sauce into the pan. Gently mix until each meatball is fully coated with the sauce bring the sauce to a light bubble and simmer for another 5 minutes on low with meatballs.

Slice your baguette lengthwise and spread a thin layer of pizza sauce on one side of the baguette. Carefully place the meatballs inside the baguette. Spoon any leftover sauce from the pan over the meatballs for extra flavor, then top the meatballs with some shredded lettuce, two cheese slices and a sprinkle of italian herbs.
Optionally place the baguette under a grill for 1-2 minutes, just to melt the cheese and slightly toast the baguette. Remove from the grill and enjoy your cheesy giant meatball sub hot!

steps: Hotpot Searing: Form seasoned protein mixture into uniform meatballs. Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High) and sear meatballs for 3 minutes to lock in a rich brown crust.
Add Sauce: Pour in 120ml sauce or broth, gently dislodging meatballs so liquid covers the base.
Pressure Cook: Lock lid and Pressure Cook on High for 5 minutes.
Finish on Hotpot: Quick Release (QR) immediately to preserve juicy tenderness. Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) to simmer and thicken sauce for 2 minutes before serving.
