instructions: Slice your chicken into thin strips and add to a mixing bowl with all the spices, a heaped tbsp of greek yoghurt and a squeeze of lemon. Mix well till coated, then set aside to marinate for 20 minutes; you can marinate overnight for a better flavour.
Slice up onion, lettuce and pickles and set aside. Then to a small bowl, add the greek yoghurt, garlic paste, a squeeze of lemon, finely chopped dill and salt to taste, and blend till smooth.
Once your chicken is marinated, add a tbsp of olive oil to a pan on high heat and let it get really hot before adding in the chicken. Cook till golden brown and set aside.
Spread the garlic sauce onto the flatbread followed by the salad, chicken and more garlic sauce, carefully fold and wrap in tin foil to keep it together. Enjoy!

instantPot.mode: Pressure Cook (High) then Hotpot / Sauté to Toast
steps: Pressure Cooker Braising: Place chicken breasts into the inner pot. Coat thoroughly with the recipe spice blend, garlic, and 100ml salsa or broth (acts as the pressure cooking liquid).
Lock the lid and set valve to 'Sealing'. Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes (fresh) or 12 minutes (if using frozen meat).

In-Pot Shredding: Open lid: the meat will be extraordinarily tender. Shred directly in the inner pot with two forks—it will soak up all the concentrated pan juices.
Stir in light cream cheese, black beans, or sauce right in the pot using residual heat.

Hotpot Griddle & Toast: To toast assembled wraps/taquitos: wipe pot dry, set to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Med) with a light spritz of oil and toast both sides for 2 minutes until crisp and cheese melts (or use Instant Pot Air Fryer Crisp Lid at 200°C for 4 mins)!

instructions: Season the steak generously with salt and pepper on both sides, then set the stove to a high heat and add some oil. once the pan is hot, lay the steak in the pan facing away from you and sear for 1-2 minutes or till you have a golden crust. Turn the steak over and sear for another 1-2 minutes.

Once you have a golden crust on each side, turn the heat to low, add a couple of crushed garlic cloves and rosemary. Once the butter is melted Baste the steak (spoon the butter onto the steak) for 30-seconds to minute on each side. Remove it from the pan and let it rest on a chopping board for 5 minutes.

In the meantime, slice a red onion and add to the same pan on medium- low heat with a little butter and brown sugar. Continually stir them till caramel brown. Once they are done, set them to the side. Spread some mayo onto one side of each slice of bread and place mayo side down in the pan to get that golden brown toast.

Cut the steak into slices, against the grain, then lay a bed of lettuce on one slice of the bread, followed by the steak slices, smoked cheese and caramelised onions. Put the lid on and cut in half. I hope you enjoy this one, it's my favourite!

title: Spicy Beef Bulking Burrito
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Add the oil to a pan on medium-high heat. Once hot, add the diced onion and garlic to a pan and fry till fragrant.

Dice the jalapeños and add to the pan. Stir for an extra 1 minute, then add in the beef, break it up and cook through. Once browned add a packet of smoky or hot fajita seasoning onto the beef, and mix till fully coated.

To reheat from the fridge, unwrap from the foil and microwave for 3-4 minutes on 75% power until warmed through. To reheat from the freezer, unwrap the burrito and microwave for 6-7 minutes at 50% power, turn over halfway for an even reheat. Optionally toast in a pan after reheating for a crispier finish.

Lay out your nori sheet on a flat surface. Spread the cooled sushi rice evenly across one half of the nori, then layer on the fillings: The spicy tuna mix, diced avocado, cucumber and carrots strips.

You can either slice it in half for easy eating or dive right in!
notes: This burrito is a flavorful twist on classic sushi, giving you a delicious, High calorie and protein-packed meal perfect for bulking.

instructions: Begin by butterflying your chicken breast, laying it flat and horizontally slicing 3/4 of the way through the middle.
Add the butterflied breast to a bowl with Nando's marinade, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, pepper, and the juice of half a lemon. Mix well till fully coated.

To make the perinaise, in a bowl, mix together sriracha, light mayonnaise, black pepper, the juice of half a lemon and mix well till smooth. In a separate bowl add 1/2 and avocado, season with salt and pepper and mash it up with a fork.
Cook the marinated chicken in a pan on medium-heat with olive oil for 5-6 minutes on each side till golden and cooked through.

Then to assemble, toast your ciabatta roll in the same pan, spread on a dollop of perinaise, followed by a layer of rocket/arugula leaves, red onion slices, the peri-peri chicken, a slice of cheese, the mashed avocado and finally the toasted top bun with some more perniase. Enjoy!

steps: Hotpot Grill Mode: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' mode on your Instant Pot and adjust temperature to 'Medium' (or 'Low' on Instant Pot Pro).
Assemble sandwich with seasoned protein, light sauce, and cheese slice. Lightly spray outer bread slices with olive oil spray.
Place sandwich directly in the heated inner pot. Use the flat bottom of an oven-safe bowl or silicone spatula to firmly press down.
Toast for 2-3 minutes until the underside is deeply golden, crispy, and crunchy.
Flip sandwich, press again, and loosely rest the Instant Pot lid on top for 2 minutes to trap heat and ensure cheese melts right through to the core.

title: 10 Minute Mozzarella Bites
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Begin by unwrapping your Babybel lights. These snack cheeses are ideal for this recipe due to their size and consistency.

Add the cornflakes to a blender and blend into crumbs, but not too finely. To cornflake crumbs, add paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and Italian herbs. Mix these well to create your flavorful coating.
Now, in another bowl whisk 1 egg, take each Babybel and dip it first in the egg, ensuring it’s fully coated, and then in the cornflake crumb mixture till completely coated.

Once all your cheese bites are coated, you can either place them on a lined baking tray and bake at 180°C for 4-5 minutes, or place them on some parchment paper and air fry at 180°C for about 3- 4 minutes until crispy and slightly golden. If using an air fryer be sure to check frequently as air fryers can vary.
Once cooked, transfer your cheese bites to a plate and enjoy while hot!

steps: Batter Preparation: Prepare the recipe batter in an oven-safe ceramic ramekin, 15cm cake tin, or silicone muffin cups. Cover top tightly with aluminium foil to prevent steam droplets entering.
Trivet Setup: Pour 250ml water into the bottom of the Instant Pot inner pot and insert the stainless steel trivet.
Place the dish securely onto the trivet.
Pressure Cooker Steam-Bake: Lock lid, set valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 12 minutes (or 20 mins for dense cheesecakes).

Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) before opening. The pressurized steam heat cooks the batter evenly without drying out the protein powder, creating a decadent, molten, bakery-style texture!
Carefully lift out using silicone mitts and allow to set for 5 minutes before topping and serving.

title: Cheeseburger Quesadillas
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: To a pan on medium-high heat add olive oil and allow it to heat up, then go in with your ground beef, press the beef flat with your spatula and let it sear for a 2-3 minutes before breaking it up, this will give the beef a delicious golden crisp!

Once seared break it up and season it with salt and pepper (use any other seasonings you like too). Cook it off for around 5-6 minutes till brown. Set the cooked beef aside and place the tortilla in the pan to heat up for 30 seconds.

Once the tortilla is warm, place the beef on one half, followed by an even topping of grated cheddar and sliced pickles. Drizzle over some burger sauce, then fold it in half and cook on both sides for 1-2 mins to melt the cheese and get it crispy.
Once cooked slice it into four segments using a pizza cutter and enjoy!
notes: These are a super quick and easy and high calorie, high protein snack. Perfect if you are short on time or feeling lazy!

instantPot.mode: Pressure Cook (High) then Hotpot / Sauté to Toast
steps: Pressure Cooker Braising: Place lean beef into the inner pot. Coat thoroughly with the recipe spice blend, garlic, and 100ml salsa or broth (acts as the pressure cooking liquid).
Lock the lid and set valve to 'Sealing'. Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes (fresh) or 12 minutes (if using frozen meat).
Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) to lock in natural juices, then vent remaining pressure.
In-Pot Shredding: Open lid: the meat will be extraordinarily tender. Shred directly in the inner pot with two forks—it will soak up all the concentrated pan juices.
Stir in light cream cheese, black beans, or sauce right in the pot using residual heat.

Hotpot Griddle & Toast: To toast assembled wraps/taquitos: wipe pot dry, set to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Med) with a light spritz of oil and toast both sides for 2 minutes until crisp and cheese melts (or use Instant Pot Air Fryer Crisp Lid at 200°C for 4 mins)!

title: Air Fryer Popcorn Chicken
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Dice the chicken thighs into small, popcorn-sized pieces and place them in a small bowl. Add olive oil, cornflour, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Feel free to add any additional seasonings you prefer. Mix well until the chicken is fully coated.

Arrange the coated chicken pieces in an air fryer or on a baking tray. Cook at 200°C/200°C for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through to ensure even crispiness. Serve immediately with your favourite condiments. Enjoy your lower-calorie crispy popcorn chicken!
notes: Chicken thighs are an absolute cheat code for great tasting juicy chicken! They also have a more calories than breasts so ideal for bulking too!

instantPot.mode: Pressure Steam (High) then Hotpot / Air Fry Crisp
steps: Steam Trivet Setup: Pour 240ml water into the bottom of the inner pot and place the stainless steel trivet inside.
Place seasoned chicken tenders/wings in a single layer on the trivet or inside a steamer basket above the water.
Pressure Cooker Steaming: Lock lid, set valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 6 minutes (tenders) or 10 minutes (wings). Quick Release (QR).
Remove trivet and discard water. Chicken is now thoroughly cooked, succulent, and juicy inside.

Hotpot Crisping: Wipe pot, spray with oil on 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High) and toss chicken in glaze/crumbs for 3 minutes to sear crisp (or attach the Instant Pot Air Fryer Crisp Lid at 204°C for 6 minutes for extreme crunch)!

title: Creamy Spicy Steak Pasta
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 800g lean steak sliced into thin strips against the grain (I used flank steak)
200ml reserved pasta water juice of half a lemon
300g penne pasta (uncooked dry weight - boil in salted water)
4 tbsp grated Parmesan (15ml (1 tbsp) on each prep) chopped parsley (garnish)

ingredientSections.name: Crispy Steak Strips
items: 800g lean steak sliced into thin strips against the grain (I used flank steak)

ingredientSections.name: Creamy Spicy Sauce
items: 200ml reserved pasta water juice of half a lemon

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 300g penne pasta (uncooked dry weight - boil in salted water)
4 tbsp grated Parmesan (15ml (1 tbsp) on each prep) chopped parsley (garnish)

instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water according to the package instructions, reserving about 200ml of the pasta water before draining. Set the pasta aside.

Slice your steaks into thin strips against the grain, season with salt and pepper, and mix until fully coated. Bring a pan to high heat with some cooking spray or oil, and once hot, cook the steak strips in batches until crispy and tender on both sides, around 2-3 minutes per side, or cook to your preference.

Set the steak strips aside. In the same pan on medium heat, add some more cooking spray or oil along with diced garlic and chili flakes. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant, then add double/heavy cream, the reserved pasta water, lemon juice, paprika, and salt and pepper to taste. Bring everything to a gentle bubble and simmer for 5-10 minutes until the sauce thickens.

Add the steak strips back to the pan with the cooked pasta, mixing until creamy and everything is well combined. Distribute the pasta into four meal prep containers and garnish each with 15ml (1 tbsp) of Pecorino/Parmesan and optional chopped parsley.
Store in the fridge for up to five days. To reheat, add a teaspoon of water and microwave partially covered for 3-4 minutes. Enjoy!

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with light cooking spray. Sear seasoned protein and garlic for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden.
Deglaze Pot: Pour in 60ml broth or water and thoroughly scrape the bottom of the stainless steel pot to lift all browned bits (vital to prevent 'Food Burn' warning).

Layer Pasta & Liquid: Scatter dry uncooked pasta evenly across the pot (criss-cross longer noodles so they don't clump). Pour in sauce/tomatoes and just enough liquid so pasta is 90% submerged (approx 350-450ml). Do not stir pasta down to the bottom.
Pressure Cooker Method: Lock lid, set steam valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 4 minutes (formula: half the standard box cook time minus 1 minute).
Quick Release: Immediately perform a Quick Release (QR) as soon as the timer sounds so pasta remains perfectly al dente.

Hotpot Emulsion: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) and stir in light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, or shredded cheddar. The bubbling pasta starch will instantly emulsify into a rich, glossy restaurant-quality sauce right before your eyes!

title: Bulk-Up Butter Chicken
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 5ml (1 tsp) all the spices in the chicken marinade
300g basmati rice (raw weight) Freshly chopped coriander (garnish)
20ml double cream (garnish) Chopped cashews (optional garnish for more cals)

ingredientSections.name: Butter Chicken Sauce
items: 5ml (1 tsp) all the spices in the chicken marinade

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 300g basmati rice (raw weight) Freshly chopped coriander (garnish)
20ml double cream (garnish) Chopped cashews (optional garnish for more cals)

instructions: Wash your uncooked rice and cook according to package instructions.

Dice your chicken breast into 1-inch cubes, then add it to a bowl with 100g greek yoghurt, turmeric, cumin garam masala, ground coriander, hot paprika, chopped garlic and ginger, salt and pepper to taste. Give it a good mix to combine and set aside.

Slice up the onion (julienne style), then melt 15g butter in a medium-hot pan and cook the onions till soft and translucent. Next, add in the same spices as you did with the chicken and mix well. Then add in the cashews, 40g Greek yoghurt and chopped tomatoes and mix it all to combine. Add everything in the pan to a blender cup and blitz it up till smooth and creamy (make sure to open the blender cup slowly after blending because of pressure build-up)

Now, in the same pan on medium-high heat, melt some more butter and fry off the ginger and garlic till fragrant before adding in the chicken to cook for around 8-10mins. Once the chicken is almost done, add in your sauce and mix well to fully coat. Cook for a further 2 minutes, then garnish with coriander and cream!
Portion the butter chicken into 4 meals, along with your cooked rice and Enjoy!

instantPot.mode: Hotpot / Sauté (High) then Pressure Cook (Low / Rice)
steps: Hotpot Sauté: Press 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Lightly oil pot and cook seasoned chicken with onions, peppers, and aromatics for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Deglaze Base: Pour in 60ml broth to deglaze the base, thoroughly scraping up all caramelized fond from the bottom.
Rice Layering: Add thoroughly rinsed rice and pour in remaining broth (1:1.1 liquid-to-rice ratio). Gently push rice under the liquid so it is completely submerged; do NOT stir.
Pressure Cooker Sealing: Lock lid and select 'Pressure Cook' on Low for 4 minutes (or press the 'Rice' smart preset).

Natural Release: Once the timer beeps, allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) so rice grains steam into fluffy, tender grains without sticking or burning. Vent remaining steam and fluff gently with a silicone fork.
Hotpot Serving: Keep on 'Keep Warm' mode at the table. Fold through fresh coriander, light sauces, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice directly in the pot.

title: Fluffy Garlic Butter Naan

instructions: In a bowl, add the greek yoghurt and self-raising flour, then mix together with a fork until you get doughy clumps, at which point you can knead it into a dough with your hands (avoid over-handling the dough with your palms to avoid it getting sticky - you can add a little more flour if needed).

Once you have a dough, use any leftover flour in the bowl to sprinkle on your kitchen worktop or a large flat surface. Rub a little flour on your rolling pin too, then roll out the naan to about 4"-5" across and 7"-8" long.
In a small microwave safe bowl, add the butter and microwave for 30 seconds to melt. Once melted, add the garlic paste and dried parsley. Mix to combine.

Now heat up a pan to high heat, melt in some butter and cook the naan for 2-3 minutes on each side. Once cooked, using a brush, coat both sides of the naan in the garlic butter glaze. Serve hot and Enjoy!

steps: Pro Dough Proofing: Knead your high-protein flour and yogurt dough. Place in a lightly greased bowl inside the Instant Pot, cover with a glass lid, and select 'Yogurt' (Low) for 25-30 minutes. The steady 38°C warmth supercharges the rise in half the time of room temp!
Roll dough into naan or flatbreads on a floured surface.

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, save a 60ml (60ml) of pasta water for later.

Meanwhile flatten out the chicken breasts using a meat tenderiser or rolling pin. Then season them up with paprika, garlic powder, salt and black pepper, ensuring they are evenly coated on both sides. To a pan on medium-high heat add some olive oil and once hot add the seasoned chicken breasts and cook for 6-8 minutes on each side till golden and crispy, then set aside.

In the same pan on medium heat add the diced onions and garlic, saute till soft and fragrant (2-3 minutes). Then add double cream, whole milk and a tsp of paprika, italian herbs, salt and black pepper. Stir on medium-low till the sauce thickens up.

Once thick add grated parmesan, washed baby spinach and sundried tomatoes (optional). Mix that all in to combine and melt the parmesan, then to get it extra creamy add the pasta water from earlier and mix once more.

Lastly add the cooked pasta, mix to coat in the creamy sauce. Distribute the creamy pasta into 4 equal servings in meal prep containers, followed by a chicken breast in each (optionally sliced) and any left over sauce in the pan on top.
Store in the fridge for up to 5 days, then to reheat add a tsp of water and microwave with the lid slightly open for 3-4 minutes, mixing it up halfway. Enjoy!

steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with light cooking spray. Sear seasoned chicken and garlic for 3-4 minutes until lightly golden.
Deglaze Pot: Pour in 60ml broth or water and thoroughly scrape the bottom of the stainless steel pot to lift all browned bits (vital to prevent 'Food Burn' warning).

Layer Pasta & Liquid: Scatter dry uncooked pasta evenly across the pot (criss-cross longer noodles so they don't clump). Pour in sauce/tomatoes and just enough liquid so pasta is 90% submerged (approx 350-450ml). Do not stir pasta down to the bottom.
Pressure Cooker Method: Lock lid, set steam valve to 'Sealing', and Pressure Cook on High for 4 minutes (formula: half the standard box cook time minus 1 minute).
Quick Release: Immediately perform a Quick Release (QR) as soon as the timer sounds so pasta remains perfectly al dente.

Hotpot Emulsion: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) and stir in light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, or shredded cheddar. The bubbling pasta starch will instantly emulsify into a rich, glossy restaurant-quality sauce right before your eyes!

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200ºC. In a large bowl, toss the chicken thighs with peri peri seasoning, tomato paste, and a drizzle of olive oil until evenly coated. Arrange on a lined baking tray and bake for 20–25 minutes, or until cooked through and slightly charred.

Slice the cooked chicken and divide the rice, chicken, and garlic bread into four meal prep containers. Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped coriander if using.

Store everything in meal prep boxes refrigerated for up to 5 days. When it’s time to eat, remove the garlic bread and lemon from the box, cover the box with a damp paper towel and microwave for 3–4 minutes until heated through. Toast the garlic bread in a pan for a couple of minutes until crispy.

instantPot.mode: Hotpot / Sauté (High) then Pressure Cook (Low / Rice)
steps: Hotpot Sauté: Press 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Lightly oil pot and cook seasoned chicken with onions, peppers, and aromatics for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.

Quick Release: Immediately perform a Quick Release (QR) as soon as the timer sounds so pasta remains perfectly al dente.

Hotpot Emulsion: Switch to 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) and stir in light cream cheese, Greek yogurt, or shredded cheddar. The bubbling pasta starch will instantly emulsify into a rich, glossy restaurant-quality sauce right before your eyes!

title: Cheesy Bulk Up Calzone
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 135g self-raising flour (sub with plain flour + a tsp of baking powder)
100g cooked chicken breast slices (deli or homemade)
150g mozzarella (preferably fresh over the grated stuff)

ingredientSections.name: Calzone Dough
items: 135g self-raising flour (sub with plain flour + a tsp of baking powder)

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 100g cooked chicken breast slices (deli or homemade)
150g mozzarella (preferably fresh over the grated stuff)

instructions: Begin by preparing the calzone dough. In a large bowl, combine self- raising flour with 0% Greek yoghurt. Mix with a fork until the mixture forms clumps, then use your hands to knead it into a smooth dough.
Lightly flour a large flat surface and roll out the dough into a thin pizza base shape. Ensure it's flat and even for the best results.

On one half of the pizza base, spread a layer of tomato sauce. Arrange the cooked chicken breast slices over the sauce, followed by sliced mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle some Italian herb seasoning on top for added flavor.

Carefully fold the other half of the dough over the filled side, creating a semi-circle shape. Press down along the edges to seal the calzone. Use the end of a fork to crimp the edges, ensuring they are well sealed.

Add a few slits in the top with a sharp knife to let steam out, then brush the top with a light egg wash and another sprinkle of Italian herbs. Bake or air-fry the calzone at 200°C/200°C for about 20-25 minutes.
Once your calzone is cooked through, slice it up and enjoy!
notes: feel free to sub out the chicken slices for pepperoni instead, this also adds a few more calories!

Pressure Cooker Mode: Lock the lid and Pressure Cook on High for 8 minutes.
Natural Release: Allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) to preserve tenderness, then Quick Release remaining steam.
Hotpot Finish: Stir in vegetables and sauce on 'Sauté / Hotpot' (Low) for 2 minutes until glossy and thickened.

title: Texas Bqq Chicken Bulk Pizza
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 125g self raising four (sub with plain flour + a tsp of baking powder) toppings
15g sliced black olives (optional) drizzle bbq sauce

ingredientSections.name: Pizza Dough
items: 125g self raising four (sub with plain flour + a tsp of baking powder) toppings
15g sliced black olives (optional) drizzle bbq sauce

instructions: Add the dough ingredients to a large mixing bowl and mix with a spoon until the mixture forms doughy clumps. At which point, continue to knead the clumps together with your hands to form your dough (avoid over-handling the dough with your palms to avoid it getting sticky - you can add a little more flour if needed).
Once your dough is formed, flour a flat surface and use a rolling pin to flatten your dough out into a base (be careful not to break it)

Carefully place your base onto a baking tray or pizza tray and spread on your tomato paste, then add on your toppings starting with the cheese, then chicken slices, red onion and olives. Finally give it a generous drizzle of bbq sauce and bake in the oven at 200 for 15-18 minutes, making sure to check on it (if you rolled out your base thicker it may take longer)
Once cooked allow it to cool for a minute then remove it from the tray and slice up, enjoy!!
notes: Note: depending on the brand of greek yoghurt you use, the dough can be stickier, if it gets too sticky add a tiny bit more flour and continue kneading

steps: Pro Dough Proofing: Knead your high-protein flour and yogurt dough. Place in a lightly greased bowl inside the Instant Pot, cover with a glass lid, and select 'Yogurt' (Low) for 25-30 minutes. The steady 38°C warmth supercharges the rise in half the time of room temp!
Roll dough into naan or flatbreads on a floured surface.
Hotpot Tandoor Sear: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot lightly and lay dough flat. Cook for 90 seconds until large bubbly blisters appear on top.
Flip and cook 90 seconds on reverse side until charred and cooked through.
Brush immediately with melted garlic butter, fresh parsley, and pink salt.

title: Creamy Cajun Meatball Pasta
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
instructions: Cook 400g of conchiglie pasta in a pot of boiling salted water according to package instructions.

While the pasta cooks, heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium- high heat. Once hot, add the meatballs to the pan and season them with salt and pepper. Cook those through, then add one medium diced red onion and two minced garlic cloves, frying until they are translucent and fragrant.

After the onions have softened, add in the cream cheese and whole milk. Mix well until the cream cheese is fully melted, then season with cajun seasoning and salt and pepper to taste. Next add in the cooked and drained pasta, mix and continue to simmer everything together for another 2-3 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly.

Equally portion the pasta into four meal prep containers and store in the fridge for up to 5 days. To reheat, add a teaspoon of water to the container, slightly crack open the lid, and microwave for 3-4 minutes, stirring halfway. Optionally garnish with chopped parsley and chilli flakes before serving and enjoy!
notes: You can also make your own meatballs with ground beef, an egg and some seasoning!

title: One Pot Muscle-building Chilli

this recipe is perfect for those days when you're pressed for time or just don't feel like

instructions: Start by dicing the onion and garlic, then sauté them in olive oil over medium heat in a large saucepan until soft and translucent. Increase the heat slightly and add the ground beef to the pan. Cook it until fully browned, then season with chili con carne seasoning, stirring well to coat the beef.

Next, add the drained and rinsed black beans, kidney beans, canned tomatoes (with their juice), sweetcorn and plain flour. Stir thoroughly to dissolve the flour. Add the dry macaroni and beef stock, stirring to combine. Cover and bring to a boil, then turn the heat down to reduce it to a simmer and cook for about 15 minutes uncovered, or until the pasta is tender and most of the water has reduced away, stir occasionally.

Once the pasta is cooked, turn off the heat and stir in the grated cheddar cheese until it melts, optionally garnish with chopped parsley. Equally divide the chilli into 5 portions in meal prep containers and store for up to 5 days in the fridge or in the freezer to enjoy at your convenience.

To reheat from the fridge add a tsp of water to the container and microwave for 3-4 minutes, stirring halfway. To reheat from frozen, microwave the chili for about 7-8 minutes on a medium power setting, stirring halfway through, until heated thoroughly. Enjoy!

title: Bulk-Up Classic Lasagna
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 500g smooth tomato sauce tbsp tomato paste

ingredientSections.name: Lasagna Filling
items: 500g smooth tomato sauce tbsp tomato paste

instructions: Begin by seasoning the ground beef with salt and pepper, then in a pan over medium-high heat, add olive oil. Once hot, add the beef. Flatten it down with your spatula and let it sear without moving for a couple of minutes to develop a crust. Then, break it up and cook until browned. Remove and set aside.

Using the same pan, sauté diced onion and garlic over medium heat until fragrant. Add the tomato sauce and tomato paste and mix well. Season with Italian herbs and cook for 3 more minutes. Return the beef to the pan, stirring to combine everything.
For the cheese sauce, blend the cottage cheese in a blender until completely smooth, this usually takes about 2 minutes. Add the eggs and parmesan, and blend again until smooth.

To assemble the lasagna, in a 12" x 9" x 3" baking dish, start with a layer of 1/3 of the meat filling, then add 240ml of spinach spread out evenly. Top with 1/3 of the cheese sauce, 4 of the lasagna sheets and 70g of grated cheese sprinkled on top. Repeat this process two more times, cover with foil and bake at 180°C/360°F for 15 minutes. Then, remove the foil and bake for another 20 minutes to crisp the top.

Cut the lasagna into six equal portions for meal prep and store refrigerated in containers for up to 6 days. To reheat, microwave for 3-4 minutes. Optionally garnish with chopped parsley and serve with your choice of salad. Enjoy!
notes: Another great option if you have a busy week ahead! Prep up on sunday and enjoy throughout the week :)

title: Chicken Tikka & Pilau Rice
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: salt & pepper to taste juice of 1 lemon
5ml (1 tsp) ground cumin (or better, cumin seeds if you have them!)

ingredientSections.name: Chicken Marinade
items: salt & pepper to taste juice of 1 lemon

ingredientSections.name: Pilau Rice
items: 5ml (1 tsp) ground cumin (or better, cumin seeds if you have them!)

instructions: Dice chicken into cubes and combine with natural yoghurt, garam masala, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, ground coriander, ground ginger, turmeric, salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix well to coat the chicken thoroughly. For the best flavor, marinate for 2-3 hours in the fridge.

Finely dice the onion and garlic, then to a pan on medium-high heat add the olive oil. Once hot hot, saute the diced onion and garlic until fragrant. Now add the marinated chicken, leaving any excess yoghurt in the bowl. Cook the chicken for 10- 12 minutes until cooked through, then add in the drained tomatoes, tomato paste and coconut milk. Mix together, turn the heat up and bring everything to a boil, then reduce the heat and let it simmer for 10-15 minutes uncovered, until the sauce thickens.

Meanwhile, for the pilau rice, melt butter in a separate saucepan and saute the finely diced onion and garlic until soft, but not browned. Then add the cumin, turmeric, cinnamon, salt to taste and dry basmati rice. Toast the rice for 1 minute then add the chicken stock and bring to a boil. Once bubbling, reduce the heat, cover, and let it simmer on a medium-low heat for about 10 minutes. The water should slowly evaporate and the rice take on a golden colour.

Once the tikka masala and pilau rice are ready, garnish the curry with chopped coriander and distribute the golden rice and curry into 4 equal portions in meal prep containers. Store refrigerated for up to 5 days. Then to reheat, microwave with the lid slightly open for 3-4 minutes, stirring well before eating. Enjoy!

instantPot.mode: Hotpot / Sauté (High) then Pressure Cook (Low / Rice)
steps: Hotpot Sauté: Press 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Lightly oil pot and cook seasoned chicken with onions, peppers, and aromatics for 3-4 minutes until fragrant.
Deglaze Base: Pour in 60ml broth to deglaze the base, thoroughly scraping up all caramelized fond from the bottom.
Rice Layering: Add thoroughly rinsed rice and pour in remaining broth (1:1.1 liquid-to-rice ratio). Gently push rice under the liquid so it is completely submerged; do NOT stir.
Pressure Cooker Sealing: Lock lid and select 'Pressure Cook' on Low for 4 minutes (or press the 'Rice' smart preset).

Natural Release: Once the timer beeps, allow 10 minutes Natural Release (NR) so rice grains steam into fluffy, tender grains without sticking or burning. Vent remaining steam and fluff gently with a silicone fork.
Hotpot Serving: Keep on 'Keep Warm' mode at the table. Fold through fresh coriander, light sauces, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice directly in the pot.

title: Spicy Nando's Chicken & Rice
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 1 (200g) large avocado lime wedges (garnish) hot sauce (garnish) - I used sriracha

ingredientSections.name: Other Ingredients
items: 1 (200g) large avocado lime wedges (garnish) hot sauce (garnish) - I used sriracha

instructions: To make the golden rice, heat up a tablespoon of oil in a large saucepan. Add diced onions and bell pepper. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 3 minutes, or until they're softened but not browned.

Remove the lid and stir in turmeric, cumin, smoked paprika, and a splash of water to prevent drying. Continue cooking for another 2 minutes, then add the rice, chicken stock, salt, and pepper. Increase the heat to bring the mixture to a boil. Then, reduce the heat, cover with a lid, and let it simmer for about 10 minutes, or until the rice is fully cooked.

For the chicken, flatten the chicken breasts with a rolling pin or meat mallet. Place them in a bowl and season with paprika, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Drizzle with a tablespoon of olive oil and mix until the chicken is thoroughly coated. Cook the chicken in a large pan over medium-high heat for approximately 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden and crispy.

Once the rice is cooked, cover it and let it rest for 5 minutes. After resting, fluff it up with a spoon. Divide the rice into four meal prep containers. Add one chicken breast to each container, either whole or sliced, along with 50g of diced avocado.

Store the meal prep containers in the fridge for up to 5 days. When ready to eat, remove the diced avocado and microwave the meal with the lid slightly open for 3-4 minutes. Add the avocado back in and, if desired, garnish with your favorite hot sauce and a squeeze of fresh lime. Enjoy!
notes: Can’t have a bulking recipe book without chicken and rice! Let’s upgrade it though...

title: Loaded Taco Beef Nachos
book: The Ultimate Guide to Lean Bulking
ingredients: 80g reduced fat grated cheddar (brand: Aldi 50% less) sliced jalapeños

ingredientSections.name: Nachos
items: 80g reduced fat grated cheddar (brand: Aldi 50% less) sliced jalapeños

instructions: Heat a pan over medium-high heat with some cooking spray. Once it’s hot, add the onion and fry until translucent. Add the beef, breaking it up as it cooks. Lightly season with smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir in 30g of diced jalapeños and cook for another 1-2 minutes.

In a reasonably large bowl, start layering your nachos. Add half of the tortilla chips, followed by half of the taco beef and 40g of grated cheddar. Repeat these layers once more, then microwave everything for 1 minute to melt the cheese.
Finish by topping the nachos with some more sliced jalepeños, Greek yogurt and guacamole. Sprinkle some freshly chopped coriander on top and dive into your delicious loaded nachos!
notes: These are a great, super quick, throw everything together kind of recipe, and not to mention...Nostalgic AF!

instantPot.mode: Hotpot / Sauté (High) then Keep Warm / Crisp Lid
steps: Hotpot Searing: Select 'Sauté / Hotpot' (High). Spray inner pot with oil and add diced onions. Sauté for 2 minutes until translucent.
Add beef mince, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, and diced jalapeños. Break up with a spatula and cook on Hotpot mode for 4-5 minutes until browned and fragrant.
In-Pot Hotpot Layering: Hit 'Cancel'. Layer half the tortilla chips directly over the warm taco meat in the pot, sprinkle with half the cheese, add remaining chips, meat, and cheese.
Cover with lid loosely on 'Keep Warm' for 3 minutes (or attach Instant Pot Crisp Lid at 190°C for 2 mins) until cheese melts into bubbly golden perfection!
Serve straight out of the warm pot or scoop onto plates and garnish with Greek yogurt, guacamole, and coriander.
